IShoppingMallCustomer.ICreate.description:
Customer account creation data structure for new customer registration in the shopping mall platform.

Contains all required information for establishing customer identity including authentication credentials, personal details, and session context for secure account creation.

The creation process validates email uniqueness, password strength requirements, and establishes proper audit trails through session metadata collection.

Upon successful registration, the system creates a customer record in the shopping_mall_customers table with 'pending_verification' status and initiates email verification workflows for account security.

Session context fields (ip, href, referrer) are essential for self-signup operations to establish comprehensive audit trails and connection metadata for the customer's initial session creation, supporting security monitoring and compliance requirements.

email.description:
Customer email address used for account authentication and communication.

Must be unique across all customer accounts in the platform. Validated against RFC 5322 email format standards.

Serves as the primary identifier for customer accounts and is used for authentication, notifications, and account recovery processes.

password.description:
Plain text password provided by the customer for authentication.

Will be securely hashed using bcrypt algorithm before storage in the database.

Subject to password strength validation including minimum length requirements and complexity rules to ensure account security.

first_name.description:
Customer's first name for personalization and identification purposes.

Used throughout the platform for personalized greetings, order processing, and customer service interactions.

Supports proper customer identification and enhances the personalized shopping experience.

last_name.description:
Customer's last name for complete identification and formal addressing.

Complements the first name for full customer identification and supports proper order verification processes.

Essential for customer support interactions and formal communication requirements.

phone_number.description:
Optional customer contact phone number for order updates and support communications.

Provides an alternative contact method for urgent order notifications and customer service interactions.

When provided, supports SMS notifications and phone-based customer support workflows.

ip.description:
Client IP address for session audit trail and security monitoring.

Optional field as the server can extract IP information from the request headers.

When provided by the client, supports server-side rendering scenarios and enhances audit trail accuracy.

Should be in valid IPv4 or IPv6 format when explicitly provided by the client.

href.description:
Current page URL where the registration request originated.

Required field that captures the exact location of the registration form for session context tracking.

Enables proper session tracking, security monitoring, and user journey analysis for registration flows.

referrer.description:
Previous page URL that directed the customer to the registration page.

Required field that captures the referral source for marketing attribution and user journey tracking.

Supports comprehensive audit trails and helps understand customer acquisition channels.

email.description:
Customer email address used for authentication and account identification. Must match the registered email stored in the shopping_mall_customers.email column.

This email undergoes validation against the customer database records and must be unique across all customer accounts. The system performs case-insensitive matching for authentication while preserving the original case for display and communication purposes.

Email format validation follows RFC 5322 standards and requires a valid email structure with proper domain configuration. The email serves as the primary identifier for customer authentication and account management operations.

password.description:
Customer password for authentication verification against the stored password_hash. This plain text password undergoes bcrypt comparison with the shopping_mall_customers.password_hash column value.

Password validation includes checking account status, verification requirements, and security policies. The system compares the provided password against the hashed value using secure bcrypt algorithms for authentication security.

While password strength requirements are enforced during registration, login focuses on hash comparison rather than re-validation of password complexity rules.

ip.description:
Client IP address for session tracking and security analysis. This field is optional as the server can extract the IP address from request headers automatically.

When provided, the IP address supplements server-side detection and is recorded in shopping_mall_customer_sessions for audit purposes. It helps track connection patterns and detect suspicious activity across authentication events.

Server-side IP extraction remains the primary method, with client-provided IP serving as supplementary information for enhanced security monitoring.

href.description:
Connection URL where the customer session is being established. This represents the current page URL where authentication occurs and provides essential context for session management.

The href value is recorded in shopping_mall_customer_sessions for security monitoring and customer journey tracking. It helps identify application entry points and understand customer navigation patterns for improved user experience.

This field provides critical context that cannot be reliably inferred server-side, making it essential for comprehensive session management and security analysis.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL that directed the customer to the authentication endpoint. This indicates the previous page or source that initiated the login attempt.

The referrer information is stored in shopping_mall_customer_sessions for security analysis and customer journey mapping. It helps detect potential phishing attempts and understand navigation flows for enhanced security monitoring.

This field provides valuable context for identifying suspicious referral patterns and improving the overall customer authentication experience.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ILogin.description:
Customer authentication request containing credentials and session context for secure login.

This DTO represents the complete authentication payload required for customer login operations. It includes email and password for credential validation against the shopping_mall_customers table, along with session context information recorded in shopping_mall_customer_sessions for security and audit purposes.

The operation validates customer account status, performs password verification using bcrypt comparison, and establishes a secure session with comprehensive connection tracking. Session context fields provide essential audit trail information for security monitoring and customer experience analysis.

This structured approach ensures secure authentication while maintaining detailed session records for security analysis, customer journey tracking, and compliance with authentication best practices.

refresh_token.description:
Refresh token obtained from previous authentication operations for session renewal. This token is validated against active sessions in the shopping_mall_customer_sessions table to ensure it belongs to a valid, non-expired customer session.

Token validation includes checking session expiration, customer account status, and security policies. Successful validation results in new token generation while preserving the existing session context and connection information for authentication continuity.

The refresh mechanism supports seamless customer experience by extending session validity without requiring full re-authentication, maintaining engagement while ensuring security through proper token rotation.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRefresh.description:
Refresh token request for extending customer authentication session validity.

This DTO contains the refresh token required for renewing customer sessions without complete re-authentication. The operation validates the token against active customer sessions and generates new access/refresh tokens while maintaining session context continuity.

The refresh mechanism supports long-term customer engagement by reducing login frequency interruptions while maintaining security through proper token validation and rotation. This operation preserves audit trails and security monitoring by extending authentication validity while tracking session activity.

This structured approach ensures customer convenience without compromising security, providing a balanced solution for authentication continuity and session management best practices.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the authenticated customer from the shopping_mall_customers table.

This ID represents the customer's primary key in the database and is used for all customer-specific operations and data retrieval. It links the authentication response to the customer's account information and personal data.

The customer ID is essential for subsequent API calls that require customer context, such as accessing shopping carts, order history, and personalized shopping experiences.

email.description:
Customer email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all customers and validated against RFC 5322 email format standards.

This email serves as the primary authentication identifier and communication channel for customer account management. It supports order notifications, marketing communications, and account verification workflows.

The email address is validated during registration and authentication processes to ensure proper customer identification and secure account access.

first_name.description:
Customer's first name for personalization and user interface display.

This field is retrieved from the shopping_mall_customers table and provides personalized greeting and user experience elements. It helps create a more engaging and customer-centric shopping environment.

The first name is included in the authorization response to immediately personalize the customer experience upon successful authentication.

last_name.description:
Customer's last name for complete identification and personalized interactions.

Retrieved from the customer's account information in shopping_mall_customers, this field complements the first name for full customer identification. It supports proper addressing and personalized communication throughout the shopping experience.

Including both name components in the authorization response enhances the personalized customer journey from the moment of authentication.

phone_number.description:
Customer contact phone number for order updates, support communications, and account verification.

This optional field provides an alternative communication channel for urgent notifications and customer support interactions. Phone number validation ensures proper formatting when provided.

The phone number supports order tracking notifications, delivery coordination, and account recovery processes when email communication is insufficient.

status.description:
Customer account status indicating active, suspended, or pending verification state.

The status field reflects the current operational state of the customer account within the shopping platform. Valid status values include: active (fully operational), suspended (temporarily restricted), and pending_verification (awaiting email confirmation).

Account status management ensures proper access control and supports security workflows for customer account management and platform integrity.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when customer account was created in the shopping mall platform.

This timestamp records the exact moment of customer registration and account establishment. It supports account lifecycle tracking, customer analytics, and platform growth analysis.

The creation timestamp provides context for customer tenure and supports account management workflows including account age-based features and loyalty program eligibility.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when customer account information was last updated.

This field tracks the most recent modification to customer account details, supporting audit trails and data freshness monitoring. Updates include profile changes, preference updates, and account status modifications.

The updated timestamp helps identify recent account activity and supports data synchronization workflows across platform services.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IAuthorized.description:
Authentication response containing comprehensive customer information and secure session tokens.

This DTO represents the successful authentication response, providing customers with their complete identification information and secure tokens for accessing the shopping platform. The response includes essential customer details from the shopping_mall_customers table along with generated authentication tokens for session management.

The authorization response enables immediate personalized experience by including customer name information while providing the necessary tokens for secure API access. It supports seamless customer onboarding to the shopping platform after successful authentication, whether through registration or login operations.

This comprehensive response ensures customers have all required information for engaging with the platform while maintaining security through proper token-based authentication for subsequent operations. The response structure supports customer experience personalization, session continuity, and platform security requirements.

IShoppingMallSeller.ICreate.description:
Seller creation data structure for registering new business accounts on the shopping mall platform.

This DTO captures comprehensive business information required for seller registration, including authentication credentials, company details, and contact information. The creation process initiates business verification workflows and establishes the foundation for seller account management.

Seller accounts undergo approval processes before gaining full platform access to ensure business authenticity and compliance with platform standards. The registration includes session context fields for audit trail and security monitoring, supporting proper session management from the initial account creation.

This is a self-authentication operation where sellers register themselves, requiring comprehensive connection metadata for security analysis and compliance requirements. The operation creates both the seller account and initial session record with proper audit trail information.

The DTO validates business information completeness while supporting the platform's security framework through session context tracking and business verification workflows.

email.description:
Seller email address used for authentication and business communication. Must be unique across all seller accounts and validated against RFC 5322 email format standards.

This email serves as the primary authentication identifier for seller access to the platform dashboard and management tools. Email uniqueness validation prevents duplicate seller registrations and ensures proper account management.

The email address is also used for business communication, order notifications, and platform updates related to seller account activities and performance.

password.description:
Plain text password for seller authentication that will be securely hashed before storage using bcrypt algorithm.

Password strength requirements are enforced during registration to ensure account security. The password undergoes hashing before being stored in the shopping_mall_sellers.password_hash column for secure authentication.

Password validation includes minimum length requirements, character complexity, and common password pattern detection to enhance account security from the initial registration.

business_name.description:
Legal business name of the seller for identification and verification purposes. Must be unique across all registered sellers on the platform.

The business name is used for storefront display, customer identification, and business verification processes. It represents the official business entity that will be listing products and managing orders.

Business name uniqueness validation prevents marketplace confusion and ensures proper seller differentiation for customers browsing the shopping platform.

contact_person.description:
Primary contact person responsible for seller account management and business operations. This individual serves as the main point of contact for platform communications.

The contact person information is used for business verification, support communications, and account management interactions. This field helps establish proper business relationships and support workflows.

Contact person details are essential for platform administration and seller support services, ensuring proper communication channels for business operations.

phone_number.description:
Business contact phone number for order processing, customer support, and business communications. Used for urgent notifications and verification purposes.

The phone number supports order fulfillment coordination, customer service interactions, and business verification workflows. It provides an alternative communication channel for time-sensitive matters.

Phone number validation ensures proper formatting and supports international business operations with standardized contact information.

business_address.description:
Registered business address for verification, correspondence, and compliance purposes. This represents the official business location for legal and operational requirements.

The business address is used for tax documentation, shipping coordination, and business verification processes. It supports compliance with regional business regulations and platform standards.

Address validation ensures completeness and supports proper business verification workflows required for seller account activation.

tax_id.description:
Business tax identification number for financial reporting, compliance, and verification purposes. Optional field that enhances business authenticity when provided.

The tax ID supports financial reporting requirements, business verification processes, and compliance with tax regulations. It provides additional validation for business authenticity and regulatory compliance.

When provided, the tax ID enhances seller credibility and supports proper financial reporting for platform transactions and revenue management.

ip.description:
Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. This field is optional as the server can extract it from the request headers.

The IP address is recorded in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table for audit purposes and security analysis. It helps track seller connection patterns and detect suspicious activity across different login sessions.

When provided by the client, it supplements server-side IP detection and can be useful for server-side rendering scenarios where client IP information is available.

href.description:
Connection URL where the seller session is being established. This represents the current page URL where registration is occurring.

The href value is stored in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table for session context tracking. It helps identify the specific application entry point and provides context for seller navigation patterns.

This field is mandatory as it provides essential context for session management and security monitoring that cannot be reliably inferred server-side.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL that directed the seller to the registration endpoint. This indicates the previous page or source that led to the registration attempt.

The referrer information is recorded in shopping_mall_seller_sessions for security analysis and seller journey tracking. It helps understand seller navigation flows and detect potential phishing or suspicious referral patterns.

This field is required as it provides valuable context for security monitoring and seller experience analysis that enhances session management.

email.description:
Seller email address used for authentication and account identification. Must be a valid email format and match the registered seller account. The system validates the email against the seller database and checks account status before proceeding with authentication.

Email validation includes format verification, domain checking, and account existence confirmation. Invalid or non-existent emails will result in authentication failure to prevent unauthorized access attempts.

password.description:
Seller password for authentication verification. Must meet the platform's security requirements including minimum length, character complexity, and encryption standards. The password is hashed using bcrypt algorithm before comparison with stored credentials.

Password validation includes strength checking and comparison against the stored hash. Failed authentication attempts are logged and subject to rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks.

ip.description:
Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. This field is optional as the server can extract the IP address from the request headers, but clients may provide it for server-side rendering scenarios or enhanced audit trails.

The IP address is used for geolocation tracking, suspicious activity detection, and session management across different locations.

href.description:
Connection URL representing the current page or application location. This MANDATORY field provides context for the authentication request and is used for audit trails, security monitoring, and session management.

The href field helps track authentication source and provides valuable debugging information for support scenarios.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL indicating the previous page or application that initiated the authentication request. This MANDATORY field is essential for understanding user navigation flow and detecting potential security threats.

Referrer information assists in identifying suspicious authentication patterns and provides context for user behavior analysis.

device.description:
Client device information for enhanced security tracking and session management. Includes device type, operating system, browser information, or application identifier to provide comprehensive authentication context.

Device tracking helps detect suspicious login patterns, supports multi-device session management, and enhances security by monitoring authentication from unfamiliar devices.

IShoppingMallSeller.ILogin.description:
Seller login credentials for authentication with comprehensive security context.

Contains the email and password combination used to authenticate seller accounts, along with session tracking information for enhanced security monitoring. The operation validates credentials against stored hashed passwords using bcrypt comparison and checks seller account status before granting access.

Security features include rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks, IP address tracking for suspicious activity detection, and device information monitoring for unauthorized access prevention. The system validates account status, allowing login only for 'active' or 'verified' accounts while blocking 'suspended' or 'pending_approval' accounts.

Session context fields (href, referrer, and device) are essential for audit trails, security monitoring, and providing comprehensive authentication context across the seller management platform.

refresh_token.description:
Refresh token for authentication token renewal and session continuity. This token must be valid, unexpired, and associated with an active seller account. The system validates the token's authenticity and checks for potential security compromises before issuing new access tokens.

Refresh tokens follow strict security protocols including encryption, expiration policies, and automatic revocation for suspicious activity. Token validation includes signature verification, expiration checking, and association with valid seller sessions.

user_agent.description:
Client user agent string for enhanced token security validation. Provides information about the client application, browser, or device making the refresh request. This field helps detect token misuse across different clients and enhances security by validating request context.

User agent validation supports security monitoring by detecting anomalies in token usage patterns and preventing unauthorized access from unfamiliar clients.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRefresh.description:
Refresh token request for extending seller authentication session validity.

Used to extend seller session continuity by generating new access tokens without requiring re-authentication. The refresh mechanism maintains seller dashboard access while enhancing security through periodic token rotation and validation checks.

Security measures include refresh token expiration policies, automatic session termination for suspended accounts, and validation of token authenticity against the original authentication context. The operation supports seamless seller experience by minimizing authentication interruptions during extended management sessions while maintaining robust security protocols.

Successful token refresh provides sellers with new access tokens while preserving their current session context, permissions, and security settings across the seller management platform.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the authenticated seller account. Generated automatically upon registration using UUID v4 format. Serves as the primary key for seller identification across the platform.

Used for referencing seller accounts in product listings, order processing, and administrative functions. The UUID format ensures global uniqueness and prevents collision across distributed systems.

email.description:
Seller email address used for authentication, business communication, and platform notifications. Must be unique across all seller accounts in the system.

Validated against RFC 5322 email format standards and used as the primary contact method for order notifications, platform updates, and business correspondence. Email verification is required before full platform access is granted.

business_name.description:
Legal business name of the seller entity for identification, verification, and customer-facing display. Must be unique across all registered sellers on the platform.

Used in product listings, order receipts, and business verification processes. The business name appears to customers during shopping and represents the seller's brand identity throughout the marketplace.

contact_person.description:
Primary contact person responsible for seller account management, order processing, and business communications. Typically the business owner or designated account manager.

Used for administrative correspondence, support interactions, and verification processes. The contact person serves as the main point of contact for platform administrators and customer support escalations.

phone_number.description:
Business contact phone number for order processing, support communications, and verification purposes. Must follow international phone number formatting standards.

Used for urgent order notifications, verification calls, and business support communications. The phone number is verified during the seller onboarding process to ensure business authenticity.

business_address.description:
Registered business address for verification, correspondence, and legal compliance purposes. Must be a complete physical address including street, city, state/province, and postal code.

Used for business verification, tax documentation, and shipping-related communications. The address must match official business registration records for compliance and authenticity verification.

status.description:
Seller account status indicating the current operational state. Valid values include: 'active' (fully operational), 'suspended' (temporarily blocked), 'pending_approval' (awaiting verification), or 'verified' (approved and active).

Determines seller access to platform features and visibility to customers. Status transitions are managed through administrative processes and business verification workflows.

IShoppingMallSeller.IAuthorized.description:
Seller authentication response with comprehensive account information and authorization tokens.

Provides successful authentication results including complete seller identity details, business information, and token-based authorization for accessing seller-specific platform features. This response is returned after successful login, registration, or token refresh operations.

The response includes both short-lived access tokens for immediate API authorization and long-lived refresh tokens for session management continuity. Seller account status information ensures appropriate feature access based on verification and compliance status.

Security considerations include token expiration management, session tracking, and business verification status validation. The comprehensive response enables seamless seller dashboard access while maintaining platform security standards.

IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.description:
Compact seller representation optimized for list views, search results, and relationship references.

Provides essential seller identification information while maintaining performance efficiency in high-volume display scenarios. The summary format excludes sensitive authentication fields and detailed business information to prevent data exposure in public contexts.

Used extensively in administrative interfaces for seller management, product catalog references where seller context is needed, and platform navigation systems requiring seller identification without full details. Security measures ensure that sensitive information like password_hash and tax details are never exposed in summary views.

The summary maintains business identification integrity while protecting account security through selective field inclusion. This balance enables efficient platform operations without compromising seller privacy or security standards.

id.description:
Unique seller identifier for reliable reference and relationship mapping. Generated using UUID v4 format to ensure global uniqueness across distributed systems.

Used as the primary key for seller identification in list views, search results, and relationship references. The UUID format prevents collision and enables reliable cross-referencing across platform components.

business_name.description:
Seller business name for quick identification and brand recognition in list displays. Represents the legal business entity registered on the platform.

Enables efficient seller identification in administrative interfaces, product catalog references, and customer-facing contexts where seller identity needs to be displayed concisely.

contact_person.description:
Primary contact person for business communications and administrative reference. Provides human-readable identification for seller accounts.

Used in administrative interfaces for quick reference and communication purposes. The contact person field helps platform administrators identify the appropriate business representative for follow-up actions.

email.description:
Seller email address for identification and limited communication contexts. Provides essential contact information while maintaining security boundaries.

Used in administrative interfaces where email communication may be required, but access is restricted to authorized personnel only. The email field enables efficient seller identification and communication routing.

status.description:
Seller account status for quick status assessment in list views. Indicates operational state without exposing detailed verification information.

Enables administrative filtering and status-based actions while maintaining appropriate information boundaries. Status values help prioritize administrative actions and identify accounts needing attention.

email.description: Administrator email address used for authentication and system notifications. Must be unique across all administrators and validated against RFC 5322 email format standards. This email serves as the primary authentication identifier and communication channel for system alerts and administrative notifications.

password.description: Plain text password for administrator authentication that will be securely hashed before storage. Must meet strong password requirements including minimum length, complexity, and character diversity. The system uses bcrypt algorithm with enhanced security measures for password hashing and storage.

first_name.description: Administrator's first name for identification and accountability purposes. Used for professional identification in system logs, audit trails, and user-facing interfaces where administrator accountability is required.

last_name.description: Administrator's last name for professional identification and accountability tracking. Combined with first_name to create complete identification for audit purposes and system administration accountability.

role.description: Administrator role defining access permissions and system capabilities. Valid values: super_admin (full system access), support_admin (customer support functions), security_admin (security and compliance oversight). Role assignment follows predefined permission sets and access control policies.

permissions.description: JSON string containing specific permission sets for role-based access control. Defines granular permissions for administrative functions, system configuration access, and user management capabilities. The permissions structure follows predefined schema for role-based security enforcement.

status.description: Initial account status for new administrator registrations. Valid values: active (immediately usable), suspended (temporarily disabled), pending_activation (requires activation workflow). Default status is typically pending_activation for security verification.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.ICreate.description:
Registration data structure for creating new administrator accounts in the shopping mall platform with comprehensive security and accountability measures.

Contains all required information for administrator registration including authentication credentials, personal identification, role assignment, and initial account configuration. The registration process ensures proper security validation including email uniqueness verification, password strength requirements, and role-based permission assignment.

Security considerations include proper password handling through bcrypt hashing algorithm, email validation to prevent duplicate accounts, and role-based permission assignment following predefined security policies. The registration workflow supports different account statuses for activation workflows and security verification processes.

Administrator accounts require elevated security measures including strong password policies, role-based access control, and proper audit trail establishment through first_name and last_name fields for identification and accountability purposes.

email.description: Administrator email address used for authentication credential verification. Must match an existing administrator account email in the system database. The email serves as the primary identifier for authentication lookup and account verification.

password.description: Plain text password for authentication verification against stored bcrypt-hashed password_hash. The system performs secure password comparison using bcrypt algorithm to validate credentials without exposing stored hash values. Password validation includes account status checks and security policy enforcement.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. While optional as servers can extract this information, providing it explicitly enables enhanced audit trail capabilities and security event correlation across distributed systems.

href.description: Connection URL where the authentication request originated for security context tracking. Provides valuable audit information for investigating authentication attempts and identifying potential security incidents or unauthorized access patterns.

referrer.description: Referrer URL that directed to the authentication page for user journey tracking. Helps establish authentication context and supports security investigations by providing complete request flow information.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.ILogin.description:
Login credentials for administrator authentication with comprehensive security context and audit trail capabilities.

Contains email and password for credential verification against stored bcrypt-hashed password_hash in the shopping_mall_administrators table. The authentication process includes account status validation to ensure only active administrators can authenticate, rejecting suspended or pending accounts for security reasons.

Security context fields (ip, href, referrer) provide essential audit trail information for security monitoring and incident investigation. These fields enable proper session tracking, security event correlation, and authentication pattern analysis across the platform.

The authentication system implements rate limiting, credential validation, and session management with JWT token generation for secure access to administrative functions. Successful authentication generates access and refresh tokens with appropriate expiration times for session continuity and security compliance.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token string used for generating new access tokens without requiring re-authentication. This token maintains session continuity while ensuring security through periodic revalidation.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. Used for audit trail and security incident investigation.

href.description: Connection URL where the refresh request originated. Required for proper session context and security validation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL that directed to the refresh endpoint. Used for security analysis and user journey tracking.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.IRefresh.description:
Refresh token request for maintaining administrator session continuity with enhanced security context.

Used to validate existing refresh tokens and issue new access tokens without requiring re-authentication. Supports continuous administrative access while maintaining security through periodic revalidation of account status and permissions.

Includes session context information (IP address, connection URL, referrer) for comprehensive security monitoring and audit trail creation. These fields enable proper tracking of refresh request origins and help detect suspicious activity patterns.

Security considerations include refresh token validation against stored session information, account status verification, and proper token expiration management. The operation ensures administrator accounts remain active and have not been suspended since the original authentication.

id.description: Primary identifier for the administrator.

name.description: Display name of the administrator.

email.description: Contact email address for the administrator.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.ISummary.description:
Summary view of administrator information for support ticket assignment contexts.

Provides essential identification and contact information for administrators assigned to support tickets, enabling proper agent tracking and responsibility assignment.

IShoppingMallChannel.description:
Shopping mall sales channels that categorize different shopping experiences or market segments.

Represents distinct content channels within the shopping mall platform, each serving specific purposes or target audiences. Channels organize articles and content by thematic categories, enabling focused content discovery and management.

Channels maintain hierarchical relationships and support content filtering, user preferences, and targeted content delivery based on channel-specific characteristics and audience segmentation.

id.description: Primary Key.

code.description: Unique channel code identifier used for system references and API calls. Must be unique across all channels and follow consistent naming conventions.

name.description: Channel name for identification and display.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the channel's purpose and content focus.

status.description: Current operational status of the channel. Valid values: active, inactive, maintenance, planned. Controls channel visibility and functionality.

configuration.description: Channel-specific configuration settings and operational parameters stored as a reference to the configuration entity.

parent.description: Parent channel reference for hierarchical channel organization, enabling nested channel structures.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the channel was last modified.

page.description:
Page number for paginated channel results retrieval.

Determines which page of channel results to retrieve from the system, starting from page 1.
Used in conjunction with the limit parameter to control result pagination and improve performance
when browsing large numbers of shopping mall channels.

Must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1. The system will return an empty data array
if the requested page exceeds the total number of available pages.

limit.description:
Number of channels to return per page for paginated results.

Controls the size of the result set with reasonable performance limits to ensure optimal
system response times. The maximum value of 100 prevents excessive data retrieval that could
impact system performance.

Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100 inclusive. Lower values improve performance
for mobile devices and slower connections, while higher values reduce pagination overhead
for administrative interfaces.

search.description:
Search term for filtering channels by name, description, or channel code.

Supports partial matching and case-insensitive searches across channel metadata.
The search functionality scans channel names, descriptions, and codes for matching
terms, making it ideal for finding specific shopping channels quickly.

Empty or null values disable search filtering. Special characters are escaped
automatically to prevent injection attacks.

oneOf.description:
Filter channels by specific operational status for targeted retrieval.

Valid status values include ACTIVE for currently operational channels,
INACTIVE for temporarily disabled channels, MAINTENANCE for channels
undergoing technical updates, and PLANNED for upcoming channel launches.

This filtering enables administrators to focus on channels in specific
operational states and helps customers find available shopping experiences.

Valid status values include ACTIVE for currently operational channels,
INACTIVE for temporarily disabled channels, MAINTENANCE for channels
undergoing technical updates, and PLANNED for upcoming channel launches.

This filtering enables administrators to focus on channels in specific
operational states and helps customers find available shopping experiences.

Valid status values include ACTIVE for currently operational channels,
INACTIVE for temporarily disabled channels, MAINTENANCE for channels

operational states and helps customers find available shopping experiences.

Valid status values include ACTIVE for currently operational channels,
INACTIVE for temporarily disabled channels, MAINTENANCE for channels
undergoing technical updates, and PLANNED for upcoming channel launches.

This filtering enables administrators to focus on channels in specific
operational states and helps customers find available shopping experiences.

status.description:
Filter channels by specific operational status for targeted retrieval.

Valid status values include ACTIVE for currently operational channels,
INACTIVE for temporarily disabled channels, MAINTENANCE for channels
undergoing technical updates, and PLANNED for upcoming channel launches.

This filtering enables administrators to focus on channels in specific
operational states and helps customers find available shopping experiences.

code.description:
Filter by specific channel code for precise channel identification.

Channel codes are unique identifiers assigned to each shopping mall channel
for system reference and URL routing. This parameter allows exact matching
on channel codes for targeted retrieval of specific channel configurations.

Useful for direct channel access and integration with external systems
that reference channels by their unique code identifiers.

oneOf.description: Sort channels by creation timestamp for chronological ordering.
Sort channels by last update timestamp for recent activity ordering.
Sort channels alphabetically by name for alphabetical organization.
Sort channels by operational status for grouped status display.
Sort channels by unique channel code for systematic code-based ordering.

order_by.description:
Field specification for sorting channel search results.

Determines the primary ordering criterion for the returned channel list.
Available sorting options include creation date, update date, channel name,
operational status, and channel code to accommodate various use cases.

When not specified, defaults to sorting by channel creation date in
descending order to show newest channels first.

oneOf.description: Sort results in ascending order from lowest to highest values.
Sort results in descending order from highest to lowest values.

order_direction.description:
Sorting direction specification for ordered channel results.

Controls whether results are returned in ascending (A-Z, oldest-first)
or descending (Z-A, newest-first) order based on the selected order_by field.

Ascending order is typically used for alphabetical sorting and chronological
views, while descending order is preferred for showing newest or most
relevant content first.

IShoppingMallChannel.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive search and filtering parameters for shopping mall channel retrieval operations.

This request type provides advanced filtering capabilities for administrators and customers
to efficiently browse and manage shopping mall channels. It supports pagination controls,
search functionality, status-based filtering, code-based targeting, and multiple sorting
options to accommodate various channel management scenarios.

The search system integrates with the shopping_mall_channels table from the Prisma schema,
ensuring type-safe operations and comprehensive field coverage. Pagination ensures optimal
performance when dealing with large channel catalogs, while filtering options enable
precise targeting of specific channel subsets.

Used primarily by platform administrators for channel configuration management and by
customers for discovering available shopping experiences. The flexible parameter set
supports both broad browsing and targeted retrieval use cases.

IShoppingMallChannel.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of shopping mall channels optimized for list displays and quick reference.

Provides essential channel identification information without the full metadata details,
making it ideal for dropdown selections, content filtering interfaces, and relationship
context displays. This summary variant balances performance with sufficient information
for most channel browsing and selection scenarios.

Used extensively in paginated channel lists, administrative dashboards, and customer-facing
channel browsers where full channel details would be excessive. The compact format ensures
fast loading times and efficient data transfer while maintaining channel identifiability.

Integrates with the shopping_mall_channels table from the Prisma schema, providing
a performance-optimized view of channel data for high-frequency listing operations.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the shopping mall channel record.

Automatically generated UUID v4 value that serves as the primary key for channel
records in the database. Used for internal system references and API operations
that require precise channel identification.

This immutable identifier ensures channel record consistency across system
updates and provides a stable reference point for channel-related operations.

name.description:
Display name of the shopping mall channel for user identification.

Human-readable channel name that appears in user interfaces, dropdowns,
and channel selection screens. Used for quick channel recognition and
content organization within the shopping mall platform.

Channel names should be descriptive and meaningful to help users
understand the channel's purpose and content focus.

description.description:
Brief description explaining the channel's purpose and content focus.

Provides contextual information about the channel's theme, target audience,
and shopping experience offerings. Helps users understand what type of
products and services are available through the channel.

Descriptions are displayed in channel selection interfaces and help
customers make informed decisions about which channels to explore.

code.description:
Unique channel code used for system references and URL routing.

Short, machine-readable identifier that serves as a stable reference
for the channel across system integrations and external applications.
Channel codes are used in URLs, API references, and system configurations.

This code provides a human-friendly alternative to UUIDs for channel
identification while maintaining uniqueness within the platform.
Unique channel code identifier used for system references and API calls. Must be unique across all channels and follow consistent naming conventions.

name.description: Display name of the shopping channel shown to users and administrators. Should be descriptive of the channel's purpose and target audience.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the channel's business purpose, target market, and operational characteristics.

status.description: Current operational status of the channel. Valid values: active, inactive, maintenance, planned. Controls channel visibility and functionality.

configuration.description: JSON configuration object storing channel-specific settings, policies, and operational parameters. Allows flexible customization per channel.

IShoppingMallChannel.ICreate.description:
Creation data for a new shopping mall sales channel.

This schema defines the required and optional fields for creating a new shopping channel within the platform. The channel code must be unique across all channels and serves as the primary business identifier.

Channel creation requires specifying the operational status which determines initial visibility and functionality. Configuration settings can be provided as a JSON object to customize channel behavior according to specific business requirements.

Security considerations ensure that only authorized administrators can create new channels, with automatic timestamp generation for audit trail purposes.

name.description: Display name of the shopping channel shown to users and administrators. Should be descriptive of the channel's purpose and target audience.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the channel's business purpose, target market, and operational characteristics.

status.description: Current operational status of the channel. Valid values: active, inactive, maintenance, planned. Controls channel visibility and functionality.

configuration.description: JSON configuration object storing channel-specific settings, policies, and operational parameters. Allows flexible customization per channel.

IShoppingMallChannel.IUpdate.description:
Update data for modifying shopping mall channel properties.

This schema defines the fields that can be modified for an existing shopping channel. The channel code cannot be changed once created, as it serves as the immutable business identifier.

Channel updates allow administrators to modify display properties, operational status, and configuration settings. Status transitions are validated to ensure proper workflow adherence and business logic compliance.

Security considerations ensure that only authorized administrators can modify channel properties, with automatic update timestamp tracking for version control and audit purposes.

IShoppingMallSection.IRequest.description:
Search and filter criteria for shopping mall section list operations within specific channels.

This request type enables comprehensive filtering and pagination for section management interfaces, supporting advanced search capabilities including name matching, status filtering, hierarchical relationships, and creation date ranges. Administrators can find specific sections within channels based on multiple criteria simultaneously, enabling complex organizational queries needed for effective section management.

The operation supports searching by section name or description with partial matching, filtering by operational status (active, inactive, hidden, archived), hierarchical parent relationships, and creation date ranges. Pagination parameters ensure efficient data retrieval for large section collections while maintaining responsive user interfaces with configurable page sizes and sorting options.

Sorting capabilities allow customized result ordering based on display order, creation date, name, or update timestamp in ascending or descending directions. This request type integrates with the shopping_mall_sections Prisma schema, providing comprehensive section search functionality for channel management interfaces and section navigation systems.

page.description: Page number for paginated section results, starting at 1 for the first page. Controls which page of section listings to retrieve based on the specified limit parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return per page, controlling result set size for performance optimization. Values range from 1 to 50 sections per page to balance performance and usability.

search.description: Text search query for filtering sections by name or description content. Supports partial matching and case-insensitive search for flexible section discovery within channels.

oneOf.description: Filter for sections currently active and visible in the shopping platform.
Filter for sections temporarily disabled but preserved in the system.
Filter for sections hidden from public view but accessible to administrators.
Filter for sections archived for historical reference but no longer active.

status.description: Filter sections by their current operational status, allowing focused management of sections in specific states. Valid values include active, inactive, hidden, and archived statuses.

parent_section_id.description: Filter sections by their parent section relationship using the parent section's UUID identifier. Enables hierarchical section navigation and management within channel structures.

created_at_start.description: Start date and time for filtering sections created within a specific time range. Supports historical section analysis and creation date-based filtering.

created_at_end.description: End date and time for filtering sections created within a specific time range. Defines the upper bound of creation date filtering for temporal queries.

oneOf.description: Sort sections by their display order within parent channels.
Sort sections by their creation timestamp.
Sort sections alphabetically by their display name.
Sort sections by their last modification timestamp.

order_by.description: Field to use for sorting the section results, controlling the primary ordering of returned sections. Available fields include display order, creation date, name, and update timestamp.

oneOf.description: Sort results in ascending order (A-Z, oldest-first, lowest-first).
Sort results in descending order (Z-A, newest-first, highest-first).

order_direction.description: Sorting direction for the ordered results, specifying ascending or descending order based on the selected order_by field.

IShoppingMallSection.description:
Organizational sections within shopping channels that group related products or categories for enhanced content management.

Represents content sections within channels, providing additional organizational hierarchy for product categorization and targeted content delivery. Sections enable finer-grained content organization within broader channel contexts, supporting hierarchical relationships, content filtering by section, and specialized content presentation based on section-specific characteristics.

Each section belongs to a specific channel and can contain products, sub-sections, or promotional content. Sections support both manual curation by administrators and automated grouping based on product attributes or customer behavior. The hierarchical organization directly impacts customer navigation and search effectiveness, making proper section management crucial for maintaining intuitive shopping experiences across diverse product catalogs.

Sections track creation and modification timestamps for audit purposes and support soft deletion for archival while maintaining referential integrity. Configuration settings allow customization of section behavior and display options based on channel policies and business requirements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall section, automatically generated using UUID v4 format. Serves as the primary key for section identification and relationship management.

code.description: Unique section code within the parent channel, used for system references, URLs, and organizational purposes. Must be unique within the channel scope and follow channel-specific naming conventions.

name.description: Display name of the section shown to customers and administrators. Should clearly indicate the section's content and purpose for effective navigation and content identification.

description.description: Detailed description of the section's purpose, content guidelines, and target audience. Helps administrators manage section content effectively and provides context for content organization.

display_order.description: Numeric order for section display within parent channel or section. Lower numbers appear first in navigation and listings, controlling section positioning in user interfaces.

status.description: Current status of the section controlling visibility and functionality. Valid values include active, inactive, hidden, and archived states for section lifecycle management.

configuration.description: JSON configuration storing section-specific settings, display options, and content rules. Allows customization of section behavior and presentation based on business requirements.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the section was created, used for auditing and tracking section lifecycle. Automatically set during section creation and preserved for historical reference.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the section configuration was last modified, tracking changes for version control and update history. Updated automatically on each modification.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the section was soft-deleted, allowing archival while maintaining referential integrity. Enables section recovery and historical preservation when needed.

code.description: Unique section code within the parent channel. Must be unique within the channel scope and follow channel-specific naming conventions. Used for system references, URLs, and organizational purposes.

name.description: Display name of the section shown to customers and administrators. Should clearly indicate the section's content and purpose. Used for customer-facing navigation and administrative interfaces.

oneOf.description: Detailed description of the section's purpose, content guidelines, and target audience. Helps administrators manage section content effectively.
Null value indicating no description provided for this section.

description.description: Optional detailed description explaining the section's purpose, content guidelines, and target audience.

oneOf.description: Optional parent section identifier for creating hierarchical section structures. Enables multi-level categorization and navigation within channels.
Null value indicating this section is a top-level section without a parent.

parent_section_id.description: Optional parent section identifier for hierarchical organization within the shopping channel.

display_order.description: Numeric order for section display within parent channel or section. Lower numbers appear first in navigation and listings. Determines section positioning in customer interfaces.

status.description: Initial status of the section. Valid values: active, inactive, hidden, archived. Controls section visibility and functionality within the shopping platform.

oneOf.description: JSON configuration storing section-specific settings, display options, and content rules. Allows customization of section behavior and presentation.
Null value indicating no custom configuration provided for this section.

configuration.description: Optional JSON configuration for section-specific settings and display options.

IShoppingMallSection.ICreate.description:
Data transfer object for creating new shopping mall sections within specific channels.

This DTO contains all necessary information for establishing new organizational sections in the shopping platform, including unique identifiers, display properties, hierarchical relationships, and configuration settings.

Sections provide hierarchical organization within channels, enabling targeted merchandising, personalized shopping experiences, and efficient product discovery. Proper section management is crucial for maintaining intuitive navigation across diverse product catalogs.

The DTO validates business rules including section code uniqueness within channels, hierarchical parent relationships, and display ordering constraints.

name.description: Updated display name of the section shown to customers and administrators. Should remain descriptive and reflect any content or purpose changes.

oneOf.description: Updated detailed description of the section's purpose, content guidelines, and target audience.
Null value indicating the description should be cleared or removed.

description.description: Optional updated detailed description explaining the section's purpose and content guidelines.

oneOf.description: Updated parent section identifier for modifying hierarchical relationships. Allows section reorganization within channel structures.
Null value indicating the section should become a top-level section or parent relationship should be removed.

parent_section_id.description: Optional updated parent section identifier for hierarchical reorganization.

display_order.description: Updated numeric order for section display positioning within the channel. Affects section sequencing in navigation interfaces.

status.description: Updated status controlling section visibility and functionality. Valid values: active, inactive, hidden, archived.

oneOf.description: Updated JSON configuration for section-specific settings and behavior modifications.
Null value indicating configuration should be cleared or reset to defaults.

configuration.description: Optional updated JSON configuration for section-specific settings and behavior.

IShoppingMallSection.IUpdate.description:
Data transfer object for updating existing shopping mall section properties and configurations.

This DTO supports partial updates of section attributes, allowing administrators to modify specific properties without requiring complete section recreation. All business fields are optional to enable targeted modifications.

Updates maintain data integrity by preserving relationships and ensuring consistent hierarchical structures within channels. The operation validates changes against business rules and channel-specific constraints.

Status updates control section visibility and access within the shopping platform.

IShoppingMallSection.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of shopping mall sections for quick reference and content organization.

Provides essential section information for list displays and content categorization without detailed metadata. Used for section selection, content filtering, and hierarchical browsing operations within shopping channels.

Optimized for performance in dropdowns, filters, and relationship displays where full section details are not required but basic identification, categorization, and sorting capabilities are essential for user experience.

Maintains hierarchical relationships through parent references when applicable, supporting multi-level organizational structures within shopping mall channels for comprehensive content management.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the shopping mall section. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format for secure and globally unique identification.

Used for database operations, API references, and relationship management between sections and their associated products or categories.

name.description:
Section name for identification and display purposes within shopping mall interfaces.

Provides human-readable identification for section selection, navigation, and content organization. Names should be descriptive and meaningful for user experience.

description.description:
Brief description explaining the section's purpose, content focus, and organizational role within the shopping mall.

Helps users understand the section's intended use case and content categorization strategy for better navigation and discovery.

display_order.description:
Sorting order for section display in listings, navigation menus, and organizational interfaces.

Determines the visual ordering of sections within shopping channels, with lower numbers appearing first. Essential for maintaining consistent user experience across the platform.

IShoppingMallCategory.description:
Category entity representing the hierarchical organization system for products in the shopping mall.

Provides structured categorization with parent-child relationships for flexible product organization and discovery. Categories support multi-level hierarchies for detailed product classification and improved user navigation.

Each category includes display metadata, activation status, and organizational properties essential for content management. Categories maintain referential integrity through soft deletion while supporting content moderation and archival requirements.

The category system enables efficient product discovery through hierarchical browsing, filtering, and search optimization based on category relationships and metadata.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the category entity. Automatically generated using UUID v4 format for secure identification and database operations.

Serves as the primary key for category management, product assignments, and hierarchical relationship tracking within the shopping mall platform.

name.description:
Category name displayed to users for navigation, identification, and product discovery purposes.

Must be unique across the platform to ensure clear categorization and prevent ambiguity in product organization and user navigation experiences.

description.description:
Detailed description explaining the category purpose, content scope, and organizational context within the shopping mall.

Provides context for administrators managing category hierarchies and users browsing products within specific category classifications.

display_order.description:
Sorting order for category display in listings, navigation menus, and organizational interfaces.

Determines the visual ordering of categories, with lower numbers appearing first. Essential for maintaining consistent user experience and logical category organization.

active.description:
Whether the category is visible and available for product assignment within the shopping mall platform.

Inactive categories are hidden from user interfaces but preserved in the system for potential reactivation or historical reference purposes.

parent.description:
Parent category reference for hierarchical structure navigation and organizational context.

Enables multi-level category hierarchies for detailed product classification and improved browsing experiences through parent-child relationships.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the category was initially created in the shopping mall platform.

Provides audit trail information for category lifecycle management and administrative oversight of category creation activities.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the category was last modified or updated within the system.

Tracks category changes for version control, audit purposes, and synchronization with related product assignments.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the category was soft deleted from the shopping mall platform.

Supports soft deletion functionality for preserving category relationships and product assignments while removing categories from active use.

IShoppingMallCategory.ICreate.description:
Category creation data structure for adding new organizational categories to the shopping mall platform.

Contains all required category information for establishing product classification hierarchies with support for both top-level categories and nested subcategories. The system validates category uniqueness and ensures hierarchical integrity during creation.

Categories can be activated immediately for immediate use or kept inactive for future deployment. Parent-child relationships allow for flexible organizational structures that support multi-level product categorization.

The creation process automatically generates timestamps and maintains referential integrity for parent category relationships. Category names must be unique across the system to prevent confusion in product classification.

Used exclusively in category creation operations where administrators establish new organizational structures for product management and customer navigation.

name.description: Unique category name displayed to users for navigation and organizational purposes. Must be unique across all categories in the system.

description.description: Optional detailed description explaining the category purpose, contents, and intended use within the product classification system.

display_order.description: Sorting order for category display in navigation systems and product listings. Lower numbers appear first.

active.description: Whether the category should be immediately active and visible for product assignment and customer navigation.

parent_id.description: Optional parent category identifier for hierarchical nesting. When specified, creates a subcategory relationship with the parent category.

IShoppingMallCategory.IUpdate.description:
Category update data structure for modifying existing category properties and hierarchical relationships.

Allows administrators to update category names, descriptions, display order, activation status, and parent-child relationships. The update operation maintains product assignments and ensures category consistency across the platform.

Hierarchical changes may require validation to prevent circular references and ensure proper organizational structure. Category name uniqueness is preserved across updates to maintain consistent product classification.

The update process automatically updates modification timestamps and maintains audit trails of category changes for administrative oversight. Parent category modifications are validated to ensure the new parent exists and is not a descendant.

Used exclusively in category update operations where administrators reorganize existing category structures or modify category properties for improved product management.

name.description: Updated category name for display purposes. Must remain unique across all categories if modified.

description.description: Updated category description explaining purpose and contents. Can be modified to reflect changes in category scope.

display_order.description: Updated sorting order for category display. Affects positioning in navigation menus and product listings.

active.description: Updated activation status for category visibility. Inactive categories are hidden from customer navigation.

parent_id.description: Updated parent category identifier for hierarchical reorganization. Can be set to null to make category top-level.

IShoppingMallCategory.ISummary.description:
Compact category representation for hierarchical product organization in the shopping mall platform.

Provides essential category information optimized for list views, navigation systems, and product reference contexts. The summary format balances performance with comprehensive hierarchical context, enabling efficient category browsing while maintaining organizational relationships.

Used extensively in product management interfaces, category selectors, and administrative dashboards where full category details are not required. Includes parent category relationships for proper hierarchical navigation and organizational structure representation.

Active status field enables client-side filtering and visibility controls without requiring additional API calls for category status verification. Timestamp fields provide creation and modification context for administrative tracking and auditing purposes.

id.description: Unique category identifier generated automatically using UUID v4. Used for database operations, API references, and category-specific actions throughout the shopping mall platform.

name.description: Category name displayed to users for identification and navigation purposes. Must be unique across all categories and serves as the primary human-readable identifier for category selection interfaces.

description.description: Brief category description providing context for category purpose, contents, and organizational role. Used in tooltips, category selectors, and administrative interfaces to help users understand category scope and contents.

display_order.description: Sorting priority for organizational context and display sequencing in category listings. Lower numbers appear first, with zero-based indexing for flexible category arrangement in navigation systems and product forms.

active.description: Visibility status indicating whether the category is currently active and available for product assignment. Inactive categories are hidden from customer-facing interfaces but remain accessible to administrators for historical reference.

parent_id.description: Parent category reference establishing hierarchical relationships for nested category structures. Null for top-level categories, references parent category ID for subcategories to enable multi-level product organization and navigation.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was initially created in the system. Used for administrative tracking, auditing purposes, and chronological organization of category management activities.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified, including name changes, description updates, or organizational adjustments. Provides modification history for administrative oversight and change tracking.

parent.description: Parent category reference providing hierarchical navigation context and organizational structure. Enables recursive category browsing and multi-level product organization without requiring separate API calls for parent category information.

IShoppingMallCategory.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for comprehensive category discovery and organizational management in the shopping mall platform.

Supports advanced category discovery through text search, hierarchical filtering, status-based visibility controls, and configurable sorting options. Enables efficient navigation through complex category structures with flexible filtering capabilities for both customer-facing and administrative interfaces.

Pagination parameters ensure optimal performance for large category collections while maintaining responsive user experiences. Default behavior prioritizes active categories with organizational sorting to provide intuitive browsing experiences for platform users.

Search functionality implements intelligent partial matching with case-insensitive text comparison, supporting efficient category discovery across diverse product catalogs and organizational hierarchies.

page.description: Page number for paginated category results, starting from 1 for the first page. Enables efficient navigation through large category collections while maintaining API performance and responsive user interfaces.

limit.description: Number of categories to return per page, with system-enforced maximum limits to ensure API performance and prevent resource exhaustion. Default values provide balanced performance for typical category browsing scenarios.

search.description: Text search query implementing partial matching against category names and descriptions using case-insensitive comparison. Supports efficient category discovery across hierarchical structures and diverse product organizational needs.

parent_category_id.description: Filter categories by specific parent category identifier for hierarchical browsing and organizational filtering. Enables focused category exploration within specific product hierarchies and organizational contexts.

active.description: Filter categories by active/inactive status for visibility control and administrative management. Default behavior returns active categories for customer-facing interfaces, with administrative access to inactive categories for comprehensive management.

display_order.description: Filter categories by specific display order values for organizational sorting and priority-based category management. Enables precise category organization and sequencing control for administrative interfaces.

oneOf.description: Sort categories by their display order priority for organizational listings and hierarchical navigation systems.
Sort categories alphabetically by name for alphabetical navigation and standardized category organization.
Sort categories by creation date for chronological organization and administrative tracking purposes.

order_by.description: Field specification for sorting category results in list displays, navigation systems, and organizational contexts. Provides flexible sorting options for diverse category management needs.

oneOf.description: Ascending sorting direction for ordered category listings from lowest to highest values. Suitable for chronological organization and priority-based sequencing.
