Descending sorting direction for ordered category listings from highest to lowest values. Ideal for reverse chronological order and priority-based organization.

order_direction.description: Sorting direction specification for ordered category listings, organizational displays, and navigation systems. Enables flexible category organization for diverse user interface requirements.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Core product catalog entity representing items available for sale in the shopping mall platform.

Stores comprehensive product information including pricing strategies, inventory management, categorization systems, and seller business relationships. Products support rich multimedia content, multiple variant options, and detailed specifications for enhanced customer engagement.

Each product maintains real-time inventory tracking, dynamic pricing history, and comprehensive sales performance analytics. Products undergo rigorous moderation workflows and quality control processes before publication to ensure marketplace integrity and customer satisfaction.

The product entity serves as the foundation for the shopping mall's transactional ecosystem, connecting sellers with customers through secure purchasing workflows and reliable fulfillment processes.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the product generated using UUID v4.

Serves as the primary key for product identification across all system operations including inventory management, order processing, and analytics tracking. The UUID format ensures global uniqueness and prevents collision across distributed systems.

Used in API endpoints for product retrieval, updates, and deletion operations. Required for all product-related database operations and relationship mappings.

name.description:
Product name displayed to customers in search results, product listings, and marketing materials.

Must be descriptive and accurate to ensure proper customer identification and search engine optimization. Product names undergo validation for length, character restrictions, and content appropriateness before publication.

Used in customer-facing interfaces, email notifications, and order confirmations to provide clear product identification throughout the shopping experience.

description.description:
Comprehensive product description containing detailed features, specifications, usage instructions, and technical details.

Supports rich formatting and multimedia embedding for enhanced customer engagement. Descriptions undergo content moderation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with platform guidelines.

Critical for customer decision-making processes, product discovery algorithms, and search result relevance scoring. Longer descriptions typically result in higher conversion rates and reduced return rates.

sku.description:
Stock Keeping Unit identifier unique per seller for precise inventory management and tracking.

Each seller maintains their own SKU system for internal product identification and stock control. SKUs must be unique within each seller's catalog to prevent inventory conflicts and ensure accurate fulfillment.

Used in order processing, inventory reconciliation, and supplier management systems. SKU patterns may include product attributes, supplier codes, or internal categorization systems.

price.description:
Current selling price of the product displayed to customers for purchase decisions.

Supports dynamic pricing strategies including promotional discounts, seasonal adjustments, and competitive positioning. Prices are validated against minimum/maximum thresholds and currency formatting requirements.

Used in cart calculations, order totals, tax computations, and revenue reporting. Price changes trigger notification systems and require seller authorization for significant adjustments.

compare_price.description:
Original price displayed for comparison purposes to highlight promotional savings and value propositions.

Typically higher than the current selling price to demonstrate discount percentages and create urgency for customer purchases. Compare prices must be logically consistent with current pricing strategies.

Used in strikethrough pricing displays, savings calculations, and promotional marketing materials. When null, indicates no promotional pricing is currently active.

cost_price.description:
Internal cost price used for margin calculation, profitability analysis, and business intelligence.

Represents the seller's acquisition cost including manufacturing, shipping, and overhead expenses. Cost prices are confidential and not displayed to customers.

Used in automated margin calculations, pricing recommendations, and financial reporting systems. Essential for sellers to maintain sustainable business operations and competitive positioning.

stock_quantity.description:
Current available inventory quantity for real-time order fulfillment and availability tracking.

Automatically decrements with each successful order and increments with restocking operations. Stock levels trigger automated notifications for low inventory and out-of-stock scenarios.

Used in availability displays, purchase limit enforcement, and inventory forecasting algorithms. Negative values indicate backorder scenarios while zero indicates out-of-stock conditions.

status.description:
Product publication status controlling visibility and availability in the marketplace.

Valid values include: draft (under development), active (available for purchase), inactive (temporarily unavailable), and archived (permanently removed). Status transitions trigger corresponding visibility changes and notification systems.

Used in search filtering, catalog management, and seller dashboard controls. Active status requires complete product information and successful moderation approval.

condition.description:
Product condition classification providing transparency about item quality and usage history.

Valid values include: new (factory-sealed), used (previously owned), and refurbished (professionally restored). Condition disclosures build customer trust and manage expectations about product quality.

Used in search filtering, product comparisons, and return policy determinations. Accurate condition reporting reduces customer disputes and enhances marketplace credibility.

weight.description:
Product weight in standardized units for accurate shipping cost calculations and logistics planning.

Used by carrier integration systems to compute shipping rates based on weight brackets and destination zones. Weight accuracy ensures proper shipping cost allocation and prevents carrier disputes.

Essential for multi-item order consolidation, international shipping compliance, and warehouse storage optimization. Supports decimal precision for precise weight-based calculations.

dimensions.description:
Product physical dimensions formatted as length x width x height for shipping and display purposes.

Used in packaging optimization, shipping cost calculations, and storage space planning. Dimension accuracy prevents shipping surcharges and ensures proper product presentation.

Supports various measurement units and formatting standards for international compatibility. Critical for oversized item handling and special shipping requirements.

category.description:
Primary category assignment organizing products into logical hierarchies for customer navigation and discovery.

Categories provide contextual grouping, search filtering options, and personalized recommendation algorithms. Each product belongs to a single primary category with optional secondary categorizations.

Used in browse navigation, category-based promotions, and inventory organization systems. Category assignments influence product visibility and search result positioning.

seller.description:
Seller business entity responsible for product listing, inventory management, and order fulfillment.

Provides business context, trust indicators, and customer support channels for the product. Seller relationships enable multi-vendor marketplace operations and decentralized inventory management.

Used in seller reputation systems, business verification displays, and customer communication channels. Seller information builds marketplace trust and facilitates direct customer-seller interactions.

created_at.description:
Timestamp recording when the product was initially created in the system.

Used for product lifecycle tracking, new product identification, and chronological sorting operations. Creation dates provide historical context for product performance analysis and trend identification.

Supports ISO 8601 format for international compatibility and precise timestamp operations. Immutable once set during initial product creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp recording the most recent modification to product information.

Tracks product update frequency, content freshness, and maintenance activity levels. Update timestamps trigger cache invalidation and search index refreshes for data consistency.

Used in change tracking systems, audit logs, and content synchronization operations. Automatically updated with each successful product modification.

IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary.description:
Optimized product representation for high-performance list views, search results, and relationship references.

Provides essential product information while minimizing data transfer for improved application performance and user experience. The summary format balances information density with loading efficiency across various display contexts.

Used in product catalog pages, search result listings, category browsing interfaces, and quick reference scenarios where full product details would cause performance degradation. Maintains sufficient context for customer decision-making while supporting rapid page loads and smooth scrolling experiences.

Summary views typically display 10-50 products simultaneously, requiring efficient data structures and minimal payload sizes to ensure responsive user interfaces across various device types and network conditions.

id.description:
Unique product identifier enabling precise product reference and navigation.

Essential for maintaining product identity across summary views and supporting drill-down operations to detailed product pages. The UUID format ensures global uniqueness and prevents identifier collisions.

Used in API calls for product retrieval, cart operations, and wishlist management from summary interfaces. Required for all product reference operations in list contexts.

name.description:
Product name providing immediate identification and context in list displays.

Optimized for quick scanning and recognition in dense product listings. Name truncation may occur in space-constrained interfaces while maintaining core product identity.

Critical for customer browsing efficiency and search result relevance. Well-structured names improve click-through rates and reduce bounce rates in catalog interfaces.

price.description:
Current selling price displayed prominently for customer price comparison and purchase decisions.

Formatted according to locale-specific currency conventions and rounding rules. Price displays may include promotional indicators or savings calculations when applicable.

Primary factor in customer sorting preferences and purchase intent signals. Price visibility directly influences conversion rates in list-based shopping interfaces.

status.description:
Product availability status controlling display eligibility and purchase functionality.

Used to filter inactive products, highlight available items, and manage out-of-stock scenarios in list views. Status indicators provide immediate availability context without requiring detailed page views.

Essential for maintaining accurate marketplace inventory displays and preventing customer frustration from attempting to purchase unavailable products.

stock_quantity.description:
Current inventory level providing availability context and purchase urgency signals.

Displays actual stock counts for transparency or may show availability indicators (In Stock/Low Stock/Out of Stock) based on configured thresholds. Stock levels influence customer purchase timing and seller restocking priorities.

Used in inventory-aware sorting, availability filtering, and purchase limit enforcement within list interfaces.

category.description:
Product category reference enabling organizational context and navigation pathways.

Provides hierarchical positioning, related product suggestions, and category-based filtering options. Category information supports intuitive browsing experiences and discovery mechanisms.

Used in breadcrumb navigation, category-based promotions, and personalized recommendation algorithms within list contexts.

seller.description:
Seller business reference establishing marketplace context and trust indicators.

Provides business identity, reputation signals, and customer support accessibility. Seller information builds marketplace credibility and facilitates multi-vendor shopping experiences.

Used in seller filtering, business verification displays, and customer confidence building within product listings.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Product creation data structure for adding new items to the seller catalog.

Contains comprehensive product information required for listing including basic details, pricing, inventory management, categorization, and seller relationships. Product creation initiates moderation workflows for quality control and ensures all required business information is provided.

Sellers provide product specifications, pricing details, inventory quantities, and categorization during creation. The system validates SKU uniqueness per seller, inventory constraints, pricing rules, and category assignments before publication. Products are created with a default 'draft' status requiring approval before becoming active.

Security considerations ensure sellers can only create products under their own account with proper authentication. The operation validates foreign key relationships with categories and sellers to maintain data integrity across the platform.

name.description: Product name displayed to customers in search results and product listings. Must be descriptive and accurately represent the product for customer identification and search optimization. Required field for all product creations.

description.description: Detailed product description containing comprehensive information about features, specifications, materials, dimensions, and usage instructions. Provides customers with essential information for purchase decisions and supports rich content for product discovery.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier unique to the seller's catalog for inventory management and tracking. Must be unique per seller to prevent duplicate product identifiers. Used for order processing, inventory reconciliation, and business reporting.

price.description: Selling price of the product in the primary currency for customer purchases. Must be non-negative and reflect current market rates. Supports up to 2 decimal places for precise pricing calculations.

compare_price.description: Optional original price for promotional comparisons and discount displays. When provided, creates strikethrough pricing effects in product listings to highlight savings. Must be higher than the selling price if specified.

cost_price.description: Optional cost price for margin calculation, profitability analysis, and business intelligence. Used internally for reporting and financial analysis without customer visibility.

stock_quantity.description: Initial inventory quantity available for sale and order fulfillment. Must be non-negative integer representing physical stock levels. Inventory tracking prevents overselling and supports stock management.

status.description: Product publication status controlling visibility and availability. Defaults to 'draft' requiring moderation approval before becoming 'active'. Valid values: draft, active, inactive, archived for lifecycle management.

condition.description: Product condition classification for customer transparency and quality assurance. Valid values: new, used, refurbished. Required field ensuring accurate product representation and customer expectations.

weight.description: Product weight in standardized units for shipping calculations, logistics planning, and delivery cost estimation. Used by shipping carriers for accurate rate calculations and delivery scheduling.

dimensions.description: Product dimensions in standardized format (length x width x height) for shipping box sizing, storage planning, and display requirements. Supports accurate shipping cost calculations and warehouse optimization.

category.description: Primary category assignment for product organization, discovery, and navigation. Products must be assigned to valid categories for proper platform organization and customer browsing experience.

seller.description: Seller who owns and manages this product for business context and ownership verification. Required field ensuring proper seller attribution and account association for product management.

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description:
Product update data structure for modifying existing product information while preserving sales history and customer relationships.

Allows sellers to update product details, pricing adjustments, inventory management, and categorization changes while maintaining product integrity. Certain fields may require re-moderation after significant changes to ensure platform quality standards.

The update operation supports dynamic pricing strategies, inventory replenishment, product improvements, and category reorganization. Products can be temporarily deactivated (inactive status) for maintenance or permanently archived while preserving historical data.

Security considerations ensure sellers can only update products they own with proper authentication. The operation validates that referenced categories exist and maintains data consistency across related entities like orders and reviews.

name.description: Updated product name for customer display and search optimization. Changes may require re-indexing for search functionality and customer discovery.

description.description: Updated product description with current features, specifications, and usage information. Supports product improvements and information updates throughout the product lifecycle.

sku.description: Updated Stock Keeping Unit identifier for inventory management changes. SKU changes require validation to maintain uniqueness per seller and prevent conflicts.

price.description: Updated selling price for dynamic pricing strategies, promotions, or market adjustments. Price changes may trigger notification systems for price watch features.

compare_price.description: Updated comparison price for promotional pricing strategies and discount displays. Supports seasonal pricing adjustments and marketing campaigns.

cost_price.description: Updated cost price for margin recalculation and financial reporting. Internal field for business intelligence without customer visibility.

stock_quantity.description: Updated inventory quantity for stock management, replenishment, or correction. Inventory updates affect product availability and order fulfillment capabilities.

status.description: Updated product status for lifecycle management. Allows temporary deactivation (inactive) or permanent archiving while preserving historical data and relationships.

weight.description: Updated product weight for shipping calculation adjustments. Weight changes affect shipping cost calculations and carrier selection.

dimensions.description: Updated product dimensions for shipping and display requirements. Dimension changes may affect packaging and storage considerations.

category.description: Updated category assignment for product reorganization and discovery optimization. Category changes may affect product visibility in different sections of the platform.

page.description:
Page number for pagination control. Starts from 1 for user-friendly numbering. Used to navigate through large product catalogs efficiently.

When not specified, defaults to the first page (page 1) to provide immediate results without requiring explicit pagination configuration.

limit.description:
Maximum number of products to return per page. Controls result set size for optimal performance and user experience.

Maximum value is capped at 100 to prevent excessive resource consumption. Smaller limits improve response times for mobile applications and bandwidth-constrained environments.

search.description:
Full-text search query for product names and descriptions. Supports natural language search across product catalog.

Uses PostgreSQL GIN indexes for efficient text matching. Search terms are analyzed for relevance scoring and partial matching capabilities.

category_id.description:
Filter products by specific category identifier. Supports hierarchical category navigation and targeted product discovery.

When null or omitted, search includes products from all categories. Category filtering respects active status and visibility settings.

min_price.description:
Minimum price threshold for product filtering. Enables budget-conscious shopping and price range targeting.

Must be non-negative value. Combined with max_price to define precise price ranges for customer search preferences.

max_price.description:
Maximum price threshold for product filtering. Supports price ceiling constraints for affordability filtering.

When used without min_price, defines upper price limit. When combined with min_price, creates bounded price range for precise filtering.

in_stock.description:
Inventory availability filter. When true, returns only products with positive stock quantities.

Essential for customers seeking immediate purchase options. When false or omitted, includes both in-stock and out-of-stock products.

status.description:
Product lifecycle status filter. Valid values: draft, active, inactive, archived.

Default behavior returns only active products for customer-facing searches. Administrative interfaces may access all status values.

condition.description:
Product physical condition filter. Valid values: new, used, refurbished.

Enables customers to find products matching their quality preferences. New products typically represent the majority of catalog items.

oneOf.description: Sort by current selling price in ascending or descending order.
Sort by product creation date for chronological organization.
Sort alphabetically by product name for A-Z navigation.
Sort by sales volume or customer engagement metrics.

sort_by.description:
Primary sorting criterion for search results organization.

Determines the order in which products are presented to users. Popularity sorting uses aggregated sales data and customer interaction metrics.

oneOf.description: Ascending order from lowest to highest values.
Descending order from highest to lowest values.

sort_order.description:
Sorting direction for organizing search results.

Price sorting typically uses ascending order for budget shopping, while popularity sorting uses descending order to show top products first.

seller_id.description:
Filter products by specific seller identifier. Enables seller-specific product browsing and storefront navigation.

When specified, returns products exclusively from the designated seller. Useful for storefront implementations and seller portfolio views.

weight_min.description:
Minimum product weight filter for shipping considerations. Helps customers estimate shipping costs and delivery times.

Measured in standardized units (typically kilograms). Combined with weight_max for precise weight range filtering.

weight_max.description:
Maximum product weight filter for shipping and handling constraints. Supports logistics planning and delivery optimization.

Useful for customers with specific shipping requirements or delivery limitations based on product weight.

dimensions.description:
Product dimension filtering using pattern matching. Supports size-based product discovery for space-constrained scenarios.

Format: LxWxH (e.g., 10x5x2). Enables customers to find products fitting specific spatial requirements.

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive search criteria and pagination parameters for product filtering operations.

This request schema provides extensive filtering capabilities for the shopping mall product catalog, supporting multiple search dimensions including text search, category filtering, price ranges, inventory status, product conditions, and advanced sorting options.

The schema enables precise product discovery through combination filters that can be applied simultaneously. Pagination parameters ensure efficient handling of large product catalogs while maintaining responsive search performance.

Advanced features include seller-specific filtering, weight-based constraints for shipping considerations, and dimension matching for space-sensitive product selection. All filters support optional application, allowing flexible search configurations tailored to specific user requirements.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the product attribute record. Generated automatically upon creation using UUID v4.

Serves as the primary key for attribute management operations and provides unique reference for updates and deletions.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent product that owns this attribute. Links the attribute to its corresponding product in the catalog.

Required for establishing the product-attribute relationship and ensuring attribute ownership validation.

attribute_name.description:
Descriptive name identifying the attribute type. Examples include: Color, Size, Material, Brand, Warranty, Compatibility.

Must be unique per product to prevent duplicate attribute definitions. Used for attribute categorization and organization in product displays.

attribute_value.description:
Specific value assigned to the attribute. Examples include: Red, Large, Cotton, Samsung, 2 Years, iPhone Compatible.

Provides the actual specification data that defines product characteristics. Values are validated against product category requirements.

display_order.description:
Numerical ordering value controlling attribute presentation sequence. Lower values appear first in product detail views.

Enables sellers to prioritize important attributes and organize specifications logically for customer comprehension.

created_at.description:
Timestamp recording when the attribute was initially created. Automatically generated during attribute creation.

Provides audit trail for attribute lifecycle management and supports chronological organization of product specifications.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp recording the most recent attribute modification. Updated automatically on each attribute change.

Tracks attribute evolution and supports version control for product specification history.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.description:
Product-specific attributes and specifications providing detailed product characterization in the shopping mall platform.

Attributes represent key-value pairs that define product characteristics such as size, color, material, technical specifications, and compatibility information. Each attribute is associated with a specific product and supports flexible product customization and detailed specification management.

The attribute system enables advanced product filtering, search optimization, and comparison features. Attributes are organized by display order to ensure logical presentation in product detail views and support customer decision-making through comprehensive product information.

Soft deletion capabilities preserve attribute history while allowing controlled removal. The system maintains unique constraints per product to prevent duplicate attribute definitions and ensure data consistency across the product catalog.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent product that owns these attributes.

Must reference an existing product in the shopping_mall_products table. The system validates that the product exists and belongs to the authenticated seller before allowing attribute creation.

This field establishes the ownership relationship between attributes and products, ensuring data integrity and proper access control.

attribute_name.description:
Name of the attribute that defines the product characteristic category.

Examples include: "Color", "Size", "Material", "Weight", "Dimensions", "Warranty Period", "Battery Life", "Screen Size".

Each attribute name must be unique per product to prevent duplicate specifications. The system validates uniqueness at the product level before allowing attribute creation.

Attribute names should be descriptive and consistent across similar products to enable effective filtering and search capabilities.

attribute_value.description:
Actual value of the attribute that specifies the product characteristic.

Examples include: "Red", "Large", "Cotton", "2.5kg", "10x15x5cm", "2 years", "8 hours", "15.6 inches".

Attribute values provide the detailed specifications that customers use for product comparison and decision-making.

The system validates that attribute values are appropriate for their corresponding attribute names and maintains consistency across product variations.

display_order.description:
Numerical value controlling the presentation sequence of attributes on product detail pages.

Lower values appear first, with typical ranges from 0 (highest priority) to 99 (lowest priority). Attributes with the same display order are sorted alphabetically by attribute name.

This ordering allows sellers to prioritize important specifications and create logical grouping of related attributes for better customer experience.

The system automatically validates that display orders are non-negative integers and handles conflicts by reordering attributes as needed.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.ICreate.description:
Data transfer object for creating new product attribute specifications in the shopping mall platform.

Product attributes are key-value pairs that define detailed characteristics and specifications for products, enabling comprehensive product descriptions and enhanced search capabilities. Each attribute represents a specific product feature that helps customers make informed purchasing decisions.

This DTO is used when sellers add custom attributes to their products through the POST /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/attributes API endpoint. The system validates product ownership, attribute uniqueness per product, and data integrity before creating the attribute record.

Attributes support flexible product categorization and enable advanced filtering options for customers browsing the shopping mall catalog. The system maintains referential integrity through foreign key constraints and provides audit trails for all attribute modifications.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
Foreign key reference to the parent product that owns these attributes.

Optional field for update operations - if provided, the system validates that the product exists and the attribute can be reassigned. Typically used when moving attributes between products during product reorganization.

If omitted during update, the attribute remains associated with its current product. The system maintains referential integrity through validation checks.

attribute_name.description:
Updated name of the attribute category.

If modified, the system validates that the new attribute name is unique per product to prevent specification conflicts. Attribute name changes should maintain consistency with existing product categorization.

Optional field - if omitted, the current attribute name remains unchanged. Name updates should be performed carefully to avoid breaking existing product filters and search indexes.

attribute_value.description:
Updated value of the attribute specification.

Allows sellers to correct or refine product specifications based on customer feedback or updated product information. Value changes are immediately reflected in product listings and search results.

Optional field - if omitted, the current attribute value remains unchanged. The system validates that updated values are appropriate for their attribute categories.

display_order.description:
Updated sorting priority for attribute presentation.

Allows sellers to reorganize how attributes are displayed on product pages, prioritizing important specifications or grouping related characteristics together.

Optional field - if omitted, the current display order remains unchanged. The system handles display order conflicts by automatically adjusting other attributes in the same product.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.IUpdate.description:
Data transfer object for updating existing product attribute specifications with partial modification support.

This DTO supports flexible attribute management by allowing sellers to modify individual attribute properties without affecting others. The system validates ownership and maintains data consistency throughout the update process.

Used when sellers modify product attributes through the PUT /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/attributes/{attributeId} API endpoint. The operation preserves the unique constraint per product and tracks modification timestamps for audit purposes.

All fields are optional to enable targeted updates - sellers can change specific attribute properties while leaving others unchanged. The system handles concurrent modifications and ensures data integrity through transaction management.

Attribute updates immediately affect product listings, search functionality, and customer-facing product details, making this operation critical for maintaining accurate product information in the shopping mall platform.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the product attribute record. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon creation.

Used as the primary key for database operations and API references. Provides immutable identification for attribute records throughout their lifecycle.

attribute_name.description:
Name of the product attribute defining the characteristic being specified (e.g., Color, Size, Material, Weight).

Attribute names should be consistent across products within the same category for effective filtering and comparison. Used for search operations and attribute categorization.

Validation ensures names are non-empty and follow standardized naming conventions for the product category.

attribute_value.description:
Specific value assigned to the attribute defining the product characteristic (e.g., Red, Large, Cotton, 500g).

Attribute values provide the actual specification details that customers use for product evaluation and comparison. Supports text search operations for finding products with specific attributes.

Values should be formatted consistently within attribute types to enable accurate filtering and search functionality.

display_order.description:
Sorting order for attribute display on product pages and attribute listings.

Determines the sequence in which attributes appear when displayed to users. Lower numbers appear first, with sequential ordering for attributes with the same display order value.

Used by frontend applications to organize attribute presentation in a logical and user-friendly manner.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the product attribute record was initially created in the system.

Provides audit trail information for attribute lifecycle management. Used for chronological ordering and historical tracking of attribute modifications.

Format follows ISO 8601 standard for consistent date-time representation across all API responses.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the product attribute record was last modified or updated.

Tracks the most recent change to the attribute specification. Used for synchronization and change detection in distributed systems.

Updated automatically whenever any attribute property is modified through API operations.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the product attribute record was soft deleted from the system.

Supports soft deletion functionality to preserve historical data while removing the attribute from active product displays. Null value indicates the attribute is currently active.

Used for data retention and audit compliance while maintaining referential integrity.

product.description:
Reference to the parent product that owns and contains this attribute specification.

Provides hierarchical context for the attribute within the product catalog structure. The product reference includes essential product information for display and navigation purposes.

Used to establish the ownership relationship between products and their attribute specifications.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.ISummary.description:
Summary view of product-specific attributes and specifications for efficient list displays and quick reference.

Provides essential attribute information optimized for performance in product listings, search results, and summary views where full attribute details are not required. The summary format maintains sufficient context while minimizing data transfer overhead.

Attributes represent detailed product characteristics that define product specifications like size, color, material, and technical properties. Each attribute is associated with a specific product and maintains display ordering for organized presentation.

Used extensively in product catalog interfaces, search result displays, and administrative dashboards where attribute information needs to be presented concisely without overwhelming users with excessive detail.

page.description:
Page number for pagination control in attribute search results.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve, starting from page 1. Used in conjunction with the limit parameter to implement efficient pagination for large attribute sets.

Validation ensures page numbers are positive integers to prevent invalid pagination requests.

limit.description:
Maximum number of attribute records to return per page in search results.

Controls the size of result sets to balance performance and usability. Maximum value of 100 prevents excessive data retrieval that could impact system performance.

Smaller limits improve response times for mobile applications, while larger limits reduce pagination complexity for desktop interfaces.

search.description:
Search term for filtering attributes by name or value using text pattern matching.

Supports partial matching against both attribute_name and attribute_value fields. Search is case-insensitive and supports substring matching for flexible attribute discovery.

Empty or null values disable search filtering and return all attributes matching other filter criteria.

oneOf.description: Sort results alphabetically by attribute name for organized browsing.
Sort results alphabetically by attribute value for value-based organization.
Sort results by display order for presentation sequence control.
Sort results chronologically by creation date for historical ordering.

sort_by.description:
Field specification for sorting attribute search results according to specific criteria.

Determines the primary sorting dimension for attribute listings. Default sorting behavior may vary by implementation if not explicitly specified.

Sorting by display_order is particularly useful for product page attribute organization.

oneOf.description: Sort results in ascending order (A-Z, oldest first, lowest first).
Sort results in descending order (Z-A, newest first, highest first).

order.description:
Sorting direction specification for organizing attribute search results.

Controls whether results are presented in ascending or descending order based on the selected sort_by field. Ascending order is typically used for alphabetical and chronological sorting.

Descending order is useful for displaying newest attributes first or for reverse alphabetical organization.

product_id.description:
Unique identifier of the target product for attribute filtering scope.

Restricts attribute search results to those belonging to the specified product. This parameter provides consistency with the operation path parameter while allowing optional override.

When provided, overrides the path parameter value for flexible attribute querying across different product contexts.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for product attribute queries with comprehensive search capabilities.

Supports advanced attribute discovery through pagination, text search, sorting, and product-based filtering. Used when searching through product specifications across the entire catalog or within specific product contexts.

The parameter set enables efficient attribute retrieval for various use cases including product comparison, attribute management, and catalog browsing. Empty parameter values default to system-configured behavior for optimal user experience.

Validates input parameters to ensure proper search functionality and prevent performance degradation through excessive result sets or invalid filtering criteria.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the product variant. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon creation. Serves as the primary key for database operations and API references.

This identifier remains constant throughout the variant's lifecycle and is used for all CRUD operations. It establishes relationships with parent products and maintains referential integrity across the shopping mall platform.

variant_name.description:
Descriptive name for the variant that distinguishes it from other variants of the same product. Examples include "Large Blue Shirt", "Small Red Dress", or "128GB Black iPhone".

This name is displayed to customers when selecting product options and helps differentiate between variant configurations. It should be descriptive enough to clearly indicate the specific variant characteristics without being overly technical.

sku.description:
Stock Keeping Unit identifier unique to this specific product variant. Each variant must have a distinct SKU within the product's variant collection.

The SKU follows the seller's inventory management system conventions and is used for tracking, ordering, and inventory management purposes. It must be unique across all variants of the same product to prevent confusion in inventory systems.

price.description:
Variant-specific price that may override the base product price. This allows for different pricing strategies for different variant configurations.

When set, this price takes precedence over the parent product's base price. If null, the variant inherits the product's base price. Supports decimal values for precise pricing in various currencies.

stock_quantity.description:
Current inventory quantity specific to this product variant. Tracks the number of units available for sale.

The system automatically decrements this value when orders are placed and increments it when inventory is restocked. Must be non-negative and supports real-time inventory management to prevent overselling.

attributes.description:
JSON string containing the complete attribute combinations that define this specific variant. Stores complex product configurations like size, color, material, and other variant-specific characteristics.

The JSON structure supports flexible attribute definitions and can accommodate various product types. This field enables dynamic product configurations without requiring database schema changes for new attribute types.

active.description:
Indicates whether this variant is currently available for purchase. Inactive variants are hidden from customer view but remain in the system for historical and reporting purposes.

Sellers can temporarily disable variants for inventory management or seasonal availability. Active status controls visibility in product listings and shopping cart availability.

created_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when the product variant was initially created in the system. Uses ISO 8601 format for standardized date-time representation.

This field is automatically set upon variant creation and provides audit trail information for product lifecycle management and reporting purposes.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp indicating the most recent modification to the product variant record. Updated automatically whenever any variant property changes.

Provides tracking of variant modification history and supports synchronization with external systems that monitor product catalog changes.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when the product variant was soft deleted from the system. Uses ISO 8601 format and supports the platform's soft deletion strategy.

Soft deletion preserves variant records for historical and reporting purposes while removing them from active product listings. Null indicates the variant is currently active and not deleted.

product.description:
Reference to the parent product that contains this variant. Provides contextual information about the base product including name, category, and seller details.

This relationship establishes the hierarchical structure where variants belong to products. The product summary includes essential information for display purposes without requiring separate API calls for product details.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.description:
Product variations with different attributes like size, color, or style options that extend the base product with specific configurations.

Manages product variants that share the same core product identity but offer different attribute combinations for customer selection. Each variant can have unique pricing, inventory levels, SKU identifiers, and availability status while maintaining the product's fundamental characteristics.

Supports complex product configurations common in e-commerce platforms, such as clothing with multiple sizes and colors, electronics with different storage capacities, or furniture with various material options. Variants enable sellers to offer product diversity without creating separate product listings for each configuration.

The variant system integrates with inventory management, pricing strategies, and order fulfillment processes to ensure accurate stock tracking and customer experience. Variants maintain relationships with their parent products while supporting independent management of variant-specific properties.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results, starting from 1. Controls which subset of results is returned based on the limit parameter.

Used in conjunction with the limit parameter to implement efficient pagination for large result sets. Page 1 represents the first set of results, with subsequent pages containing additional records.

limit.description:
Maximum number of product variants to return per page. Controls the size of each paginated result set for efficient data retrieval.

Smaller limits improve performance for large datasets, while larger limits reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve complete result sets. Must be a positive integer.

search.description:
Text search query for filtering product variants by name or SKU. Supports partial matching and case-insensitive searches.

The search functionality scans variant names and SKU values for matches, making it easier to find specific variants in large catalogs. Empty or null values disable text-based filtering.

active.description:
Filter to include only active or inactive product variants. When true, returns only variants available for purchase; when false, returns only inactive variants.

This filter helps sellers manage product availability and customers browse only available options. Null or undefined values include both active and inactive variants.

min_stock.description:
Minimum stock quantity filter. Returns only variants with inventory levels equal to or greater than the specified value.

Useful for inventory management and identifying variants that need restocking. Helps sellers focus on variants with sufficient inventory for sales.

max_stock.description:
Maximum stock quantity filter. Returns only variants with inventory levels equal to or less than the specified value.

Helps identify overstocked items or variants with limited availability. Combined with min_stock, creates inventory range filtering.

min_price.description:
Minimum price filter. Returns only variants with prices equal to or greater than the specified value.

Supports price-based filtering for customers with specific budget constraints and sellers analyzing pricing strategies across variants.

max_price.description:
Maximum price filter. Returns only variants with prices equal to or less than the specified value.

Enables price range filtering for both customer browsing and seller price analysis. Combined with min_price, creates comprehensive price-based filtering.

oneOf.description: Sort results by the creation timestamp of product variants. Useful for viewing recently added variants or analyzing product lifecycle patterns.
Sort results alphabetically by variant name. Provides organized browsing experience and helps with inventory management.
Sort results by variant price. Enables price-based browsing from lowest to highest or vice versa for customer decision making.
Sort results by inventory quantity. Helps identify well-stocked or low-inventory variants for inventory management purposes.

order_by.description:
Field to use for sorting the product variant results. Determines the primary sorting criteria for the returned variant list.

Each sorting option serves different use cases: creation date for recent additions, variant name for alphabetical organization, price for cost-based browsing, and stock quantity for inventory management.

oneOf.description: Ascending order sorting. Arranges results from smallest to largest values, such as oldest to newest or lowest to highest prices.
Descending order sorting. Arranges results from largest to smallest values, such as newest to oldest or highest to lowest prices.

order_direction.description:
Direction for sorting the product variant results. Controls whether results are arranged in ascending or descending order based on the selected order_by field.

Ascending order is typically used for chronological sorting or low-to-high pricing, while descending order is used for reverse chronological sorting or high-to-low pricing.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering product variants in the shopping mall catalog with comprehensive filtering capabilities.

This request type provides advanced search functionality for product variant management, supporting multiple filtering dimensions including text search, status filtering, inventory level ranges, price ranges, and sophisticated sorting options. The flexible filtering system enables both sellers and administrators to efficiently manage large product variant collections.

Used primarily in variant listing operations where users need to find specific variants based on multiple criteria. The pagination system ensures efficient handling of large result sets while maintaining performance. The filtering capabilities support complex business scenarios like inventory management, price analysis, and product catalog organization.

Security considerations ensure that filtering operations respect user permissions and only return variants accessible to the requesting user based on their role and product ownership relationships.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
Parent product identifier that this variant belongs to. References the shopping_mall_products.id field. Must be a valid UUID that exists in the products table and belongs to the authenticated seller.

This field establishes the parent-child relationship between products and their variants. The operation validates that the product exists and the seller has permission to modify it before creating the variant.

variant_name.description:
Descriptive name for the product variant that distinguishes it from other variants. Examples include 'Large Blue Shirt', 'Small Red Dress', or '32GB Black Model'.

Used for display purposes in product listings and variant selection interfaces. Should clearly communicate the variant's distinguishing characteristics to customers.

sku.description:
Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier for this specific product variant. Must be unique within the parent product's variant collection.

Used for inventory management, order processing, and product identification. The system validates SKU uniqueness at the product level to prevent duplicate variant identification.

price.description:
Variant-specific selling price that overrides the parent product's base price when different. Can be null to inherit the parent product's price.

Used when variants have different pricing strategies based on attributes, materials, or production costs. Null values indicate the variant should use the parent product's pricing.

stock_quantity.description:
Inventory quantity specific to this product variant. Represents the available stock for this particular configuration.

Used for inventory tracking and stock availability calculations. Separate from the parent product's inventory to manage variant-specific stock levels.

attributes.description:
JSON string containing variant attribute combinations and configuration data. Can be null for variants without complex attribute configurations.

Stores structured data representing variant options like size, color, material, or other product specifications. The JSON format allows flexible attribute management for complex product configurations.

active.description:
Indicates whether this variant is available for purchase. New variants are active by default unless explicitly set to inactive.

Controls variant visibility in product listings and availability for customer selection. Inactive variants remain in the system for historical purposes but are not available for new purchases.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ICreate.description:
Creation data transfer object for product variants with different attributes like size, color, or style options.

Used when sellers add new variant configurations to their existing products in the shopping mall catalog. Each variant represents a specific product configuration with unique pricing, inventory levels, SKU identifiers, and attribute combinations.

Supports complex product option management where customers can select from multiple variant choices. The operation validates business rules including parent product ownership, SKU uniqueness, and inventory constraints before creating the variant.

Integrates with the shopping_mall_product_variants table from the Prisma schema, establishing proper relationships to parent products while maintaining data consistency across the product catalog system.

shopping_mall_product_id.description:
Parent product identifier that this variant belongs to. References the shopping_mall_products.id field. This field is immutable after creation and typically should not be updated.

Included for completeness but generally should not be modified as it would change the variant's parent relationship. Null values indicate the field should not be updated.

variant_name.description:
Descriptive name for the product variant that distinguishes it from other variants. Examples include 'Large Blue Shirt', 'Small Red Dress', or '32GB Black Model'.

Used for display purposes in product listings and variant selection interfaces. Can be updated to improve clarity or reflect changes in variant characteristics.

sku.description:
Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier for this specific product variant. Must remain unique within the parent product's variant collection if updated.

Used for inventory management and product identification. The system validates SKU uniqueness when modified to prevent conflicts with existing variants.

price.description:
Variant-specific selling price that overrides the parent product's base price. Can be updated to reflect pricing changes or set to null to inherit the parent product's price.

Used when variants require price adjustments due to cost changes, promotions, or market conditions. Null values revert to parent product pricing.

stock_quantity.description:
Inventory quantity specific to this product variant. Represents the available stock for this particular configuration.

Used for inventory management and stock level adjustments. Can be updated to reflect new inventory arrivals, sales, or stock corrections.

attributes.description:
JSON string containing variant attribute combinations and configuration data. Can be updated to modify variant specifications or set to null for simplified variants.

Stores structured data representing variant options. Updates allow sellers to refine product configurations or add new attribute combinations.

active.description:
Indicates whether this variant is available for purchase. Can be updated to temporarily disable variants or reactivate previously inactive ones.

Controls variant visibility and availability. Useful for managing seasonal products, temporary stockouts, or product lifecycle changes.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IUpdate.description:
Update data transfer object for modifying existing product variants with different attributes like size, color, or style options.

Used when sellers need to update variant details such as pricing adjustments, inventory changes, attribute modifications, or availability status. Supports partial updates where only specific fields are modified while preserving existing values for unchanged fields.

The operation validates business rules including SKU uniqueness constraints, inventory integrity, and seller ownership permissions. Security considerations ensure that only the authenticated seller who owns both the product and variant can perform updates.

Integrates with the shopping_mall_product_variants table from the Prisma schema, maintaining data consistency while allowing flexible variant management through the seller dashboard interface.

id.description:
Primary key identifier for the product image record.

System-generated UUID that uniquely identifies this product image. This field is managed by the database and should not be exposed in request DTOs where it could be manipulated.

product.description:
Product that owns this image, providing complete context for display and management.

References the parent product entity using summary view to prevent circular references while providing essential product information needed for proper image context and display.

Security Note: This relationship is validated server-side to ensure the authenticated user has appropriate access rights to the referenced product.

image_url.description:
URL pointing to the stored product image resource.

This URL must be accessible and point to a valid image file that can be displayed in product galleries and listings. The system validates that the URL follows proper URI format and points to supported image formats.

Security Note: URLs are validated to prevent malicious content injection and ensure they point to approved storage locations.

alt_text.description:
Alternative text description for accessibility and SEO purposes.

Provides descriptive text for screen readers and search engines when the image cannot be displayed. Should accurately describe the image content and context within the product presentation.

Security Note: Content is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks while maintaining accessibility functionality.

is_primary.description:
Indicates whether this image is the primary product image.

The primary image is displayed as the main visual representation in product listings, search results, and primary product views. Only one image per product can be marked as primary at any given time.

Security Note: Primary status changes are validated to ensure the authenticated seller owns the product and has permission to modify image properties.

display_order.description:
Sorting order for image display sequence in product galleries.

Determines the position of this image within the product's image gallery. Lower numbers appear first, with sequential ordering allowing proper gallery navigation and presentation flow.

Security Note: Display order modifications are validated to prevent unauthorized reordering of product images.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the image was uploaded to the system.

Records the exact date and time when this product image was initially created and associated with the product. Used for audit trails, sorting by upload date, and tracking image lifecycle.

Security Note: This timestamp is system-generated and cannot be modified by users, ensuring accurate audit trail maintenance.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the image metadata was last modified.

Tracks the most recent update to image properties such as alt text, primary status, or display order. Helps identify recent changes and maintain version control for image management.

Security Note: Automatically updated by the system whenever image properties are modified, providing reliable change tracking.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the image was soft deleted from the system.

Records the date and time when this image was marked for deletion using soft delete functionality. Allows for recovery of accidentally deleted images while maintaining referential integrity.

Security Note: Only administrators can permanently delete images; soft deletion preserves data for audit purposes.

IShoppingMallProductImage.description:
Product image entity representing visual assets associated with shopping mall products.

Manages product image metadata including URL references, accessibility text, display configuration, and gallery sequencing. Each image is linked to a specific product and supports multiple display configurations for optimal product presentation. Images are organized hierarchically with primary image designation for main product representation and sequential ordering for gallery displays.

The entity integrates with product catalog management to provide comprehensive visual product information. Supports soft deletion functionality for data preservation while maintaining referential integrity. Timestamps track image lifecycle from creation through updates and potential deletion.

Security Context: All image operations require proper authentication and authorization validation. Product ownership is verified server-side to prevent unauthorized access to product images. System-generated fields ensure data integrity and accurate audit trail maintenance.

page.description:
Page number for pagination (starting from 1).

Used to navigate through large sets of product images efficiently. The system enforces reasonable limits to prevent excessive resource consumption.

limit.description:
Number of items per page for pagination.

Controls the number of images returned per request. The system imposes maximum limits to maintain performance and prevent denial of service attacks.

search.description:
Search term for filtering images by alt text or URL.

Supports text-based filtering of product images. Search terms are sanitized to prevent injection attacks while maintaining search functionality.

is_primary.description:
Filter by primary image status.

Allows filtering to show only primary images or only non-primary images. This filter respects product ownership boundaries.

display_order_min.description:
Minimum display order value for filtering.

Used to filter images by their position in the gallery sequence. Combined with display_order_max for range-based filtering.

display_order_max.description:
Maximum display order value for filtering.

Used with display_order_min to define a range of display positions to include in the results.

created_at_min.description:
Minimum creation timestamp for filtering images by upload date.

Used to filter images uploaded after a specific date and time. Combined with created_at_max for date range filtering of image uploads.

created_at_max.description:
Maximum creation timestamp for filtering images by upload date.

Used to filter images uploaded before a specific date and time. Combined with created_at_min for date range filtering of image uploads.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for product image filtering.

This request type supports comprehensive searching, filtering, and paginating through product images. Users can search by alt text content, filter by primary image status, specify display order ranges, and filter by upload date ranges using timestamp-based criteria.

Pagination parameters allow for efficient navigation through large image galleries while maintaining performance. Date range filtering enables users to find images uploaded within specific time periods, supporting use cases like finding recently added images or images from a particular campaign period.

Security Context: All search operations are scoped to products owned by the authenticated seller. The system validates that users can only search images for products they have permission to access. Filter parameters are validated to prevent injection attacks and ensure proper data handling.

image_url.description:
URL pointing to the stored product image resource that has been pre-uploaded to the storage service.

Must be a valid, accessible URL pointing to an image file in a supported format (JPEG, PNG, WebP, etc.). The image should be optimized for web display with appropriate dimensions and file size. The system validates URL accessibility and format compatibility before accepting the image reference.

Security considerations include validating that the URL points to approved storage locations and preventing malicious content injection through URL manipulation.

alt_text.description:
Alternative text description for accessibility and search engine optimization.

Should provide a concise, accurate description of the image content that would be meaningful to users who cannot see the image. Typically describes the product feature or context shown in the image.

This field is optional but strongly recommended for compliance with web accessibility standards (WCAG) and improved search engine visibility. Content is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks while maintaining descriptive functionality.

is_primary.description:
Specifies whether this image should be set as the primary product image.

If set to true, this image becomes the main representation for the product. If another primary image exists, it will be automatically demoted to non-primary status. Defaults to false if not specified.

The primary image is displayed as the main visual in product listings, search results, and primary product views. Only one image per product can be marked as primary at any given time.

display_order.description:
Position in the image display sequence for the product gallery.

Determines the order in which this image appears relative to other product images. Lower numbers display first. If not specified, the image is appended to the end of the existing gallery.

Display order ensures proper sequencing in product galleries and allows sellers to control the visual presentation flow of their product images. The system validates that display order values are unique within the product's image collection.

IShoppingMallProductImage.ICreate.description:
Data transfer object for creating new product image associations in the shopping mall catalog.

Used when sellers upload and associate images with their products, providing comprehensive image metadata including URL references, accessibility text, display configuration, and gallery sequencing. The DTO ensures proper image organization and presentation within the product gallery system.

Security considerations: The product ID is obtained from the path parameter and the seller identity is derived from authentication context, so these are not included in the request body. Ownership validation occurs server-side to ensure sellers can only add images to products they own.

Business rules: Image creation triggers validation of URL accessibility, format compatibility, and gallery sequencing logic. Primary image designation automatically manages existing primary images to maintain single-primary-image constraint per product.

image_url.description:
Updated URL pointing to a replacement product image resource.

If provided, replaces the existing image with a new one while maintaining the same image record and metadata. Must point to a valid, accessible image file that has been pre-uploaded to the storage service.

The system validates the new URL for accessibility and format compatibility before accepting the update. Security measures prevent malicious content injection through URL manipulation.

alt_text.description:
Updated alternative text description for the product image.

If provided, replaces the existing alt text with new descriptive content for accessibility and SEO purposes. This field is optional but recommended for maintaining web accessibility standards.

Content is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks while preserving descriptive functionality for screen readers and search engines.

is_primary.description:
Updated primary image status for the product.

If set to true, promotes this image to primary status and demotes any existing primary image. If set to false, removes primary status from this image without promoting another.

The system automatically manages primary image transitions to ensure only one image per product maintains primary status at any given time. This field allows sellers to reconfigure their product's main visual representation.

display_order.description:
Updated display position in the product image gallery sequence.

If provided, changes the image's position in the display order, which may require reordering other images to maintain proper gallery sequencing. Lower numbers appear first in the gallery.

The system validates that display order values remain unique within the product's image collection and adjusts sequencing accordingly to prevent conflicts.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IUpdate.description:
Data transfer object for updating existing product image properties with partial modification support.

Allows sellers to modify image metadata, replace image content, or reconfigure gallery display settings without requiring complete record replacement. Supports targeted updates where only specified fields are modified, leaving unspecified properties unchanged.

Security considerations include ownership verification to prevent unauthorized modifications to product images. The system validates that both the product and image exist and belong to the authenticated seller before processing updates.

Business rules: Partial updates maintain data integrity by validating ownership, ensuring gallery consistency, and managing primary image transitions. The operation supports flexible image management while preserving existing metadata for unchanged fields.

id.description: Primary Key.

image_url.description: URL pointing to the stored product image.

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility and SEO purposes.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the main product image for listings.

display_order.description: Sorting order for image display in product galleries.

IShoppingMallProductImage.ISummary.description:
Summary view of product images optimized for list displays and gallery presentations.

Provides essential image information including URL, alt text, and display properties while excluding detailed metadata and relationship data. Suitable for product galleries, thumbnails, and quick image references where performance and payload size are critical considerations.

Maintains key properties needed for proper image rendering and accessibility while keeping payload size minimal for optimal performance in list views and search results. The summary format ensures efficient data transfer while preserving essential visual context for product browsing experiences.

IShoppingMallSale.description:
Sale entity representing completed purchase transactions in the shopping mall platform with comprehensive financial and relationship tracking.

Records finalized sales with complete transaction details including pricing, quantities, commission structures, and participant relationships. Sales are created when orders are successfully processed and paid, serving as the authoritative record for financial reporting, seller payouts, and customer order history.

Each sale maintains strong relationships with the original order, purchasing customer, and receiving seller, providing complete transaction context for analytics, dispute resolution, and business intelligence. Sales data supports revenue tracking, commission calculations, and platform performance metrics across the entire shopping ecosystem.

The sale entity includes financial reconciliation details such as gross sale amount, commission rates, and net payout calculations, making it essential for accounting, tax reporting, and seller compensation processes. Soft deletion support preserves historical transaction records while maintaining data integrity for compliance and auditing requirements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sale transaction.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Original order that generated this sale. Maintained as ID reference to prevent circular dependencies since the order entity contains a sales array relationship.

sale_amount.description: Total sale amount including taxes, shipping, and applicable fees.

item_count.description: Total number of items sold in this transaction.

sale_status.description: Current status of the sale transaction. Valid values: completed (successful transaction), refunded (full or partial refund processed), disputed (transaction under investigation or chargeback).

commission_rate.description: Platform commission percentage applied to this sale for revenue sharing calculations.

net_amount.description: Final amount after commission and fees for seller payout, representing the seller's actual earnings.

sale_date.description: Timestamp when the sale was finalized and recorded in the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the sale record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the sale was last modified.

IShoppingMallSale.ISummary.description:
Compact sale representation for list views and reporting purposes in the shopping mall platform.

Provides essential sale transaction information optimized for performance in list displays, seller dashboards, customer purchase history, and administrative reports. The summary format excludes detailed financial calculations and audit trails while maintaining key transaction context for efficient browsing.

Each sale represents a completed purchase transaction with financial commitments, linking to the original order for tracking purposes. The summary includes commission calculations and net payout amounts for seller financial reporting, while maintaining relationships to customer and seller entities for comprehensive transaction context.

Used primarily in paginated search results where full sale details are not required, supporting both seller-specific views (filtered by seller ownership) and administrative overviews (across all sellers) with appropriate access controls.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sale transaction record. Generated automatically upon sale creation using UUID v4 for global uniqueness and security.

sale_amount.description: Total sale amount including taxes and shipping charges. Represents the gross transaction value before commission deductions and platform fees.

sale_date.description: Timestamp when the sale was finalized and recorded in the system. Used for temporal filtering and chronological ordering of transaction records.

item_count.description: Total number of distinct items sold in this transaction. Provides quick insight into transaction complexity and product diversity.

sale_status.description: Current operational status of the sale transaction. Valid values: completed (successful transaction), refunded (full or partial refund processed), disputed (customer or seller dispute active).

commission_rate.description: Platform commission percentage applied to this sale. Determines the platform's revenue share from the transaction based on seller agreement terms.

net_amount.description: Final amount payable to the seller after commission and fee deductions. Represents the seller's actual earnings from the transaction.

customer.description: Customer who made the purchase, providing essential identification and relationship context for the transaction.

seller.description: Seller who received the sale, establishing the business relationship and ownership context for transaction reporting.

order.description: Original order that generated this sale, maintaining traceability back to the customer's purchase intent and initial transaction details.

IShoppingMallSale.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering criteria for sales transaction queries across the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities for sales records stored in the shopping_mall_sales table, supporting complex search scenarios for business intelligence, financial reporting, and transaction analysis. The search interface accommodates both simple keyword searches and advanced multi-criteria filtering.

Supports filtering by sale status (completed, refunded, disputed), financial thresholds (amount ranges, commission rates, net amounts), temporal ranges (sale dates), and quantitative metrics (item counts). Pagination parameters control result set management for large datasets, while sorting options enable flexible result ordering.

Security considerations ensure appropriate data access based on user roles: sellers can only search their own sales transactions, while administrators have platform-wide access. All searches respect data privacy and financial confidentiality requirements.

page.description: Page number for paginated results using 1-based indexing. Determines which segment of the result set to retrieve for large datasets.

limit.description: Number of sale records to return per page. Controls result set size for performance optimization, with maximum limit of 100 records per request.

search.description: Free-text search across sale identifiers, customer names, or order references. Supports partial matching for flexible discovery of relevant transactions.

oneOf.description: Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.
Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.
Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.

sale_status.description: Filter by specific sale status values. Enables targeted searching for transactions in particular operational states for reporting and analysis.

min_amount.description: Minimum sale amount filter (inclusive). Sets lower financial threshold for transaction value filtering in currency units.
