IShoppingMallInquiry.ICreate.description:
Creation data transfer object for submitting new customer support inquiries in the shopping mall platform.

This DTO contains all customer-provided information required to create a comprehensive support inquiry, including detailed problem descriptions, categorization metadata, and urgency assessments. The structure ensures that inquiries contain sufficient information for effective support handling while maintaining data integrity through validation rules.

The creation process automatically assigns system-generated fields such as unique identifiers, creation timestamps, and initial workflow states. Customer attribution is handled through polymorphic ownership relationships established in corresponding subtype tables to maintain proper data relationships and access controls.

Inquiry submissions trigger automated workflow processes including initial categorization, priority assessment, and routing to appropriate support teams based on the specified inquiry type and urgency level.

title.description:
Brief summary of the inquiry issue or question that provides quick context for support staff when reviewing the inquiry list.

The title should be concise yet descriptive enough to identify the core issue without requiring full body content review. Support staff use titles to quickly categorize and prioritize inquiries during triage processes.

Title updates are typically allowed for clarification purposes but should maintain the original intent of the inquiry to preserve context continuity.

body.description:
Detailed description of the inquiry including specific questions, issues, or requests for assistance that provides comprehensive context for support resolution.

This field contains the complete narrative of the customer's concern, including any relevant background information, error messages, or specific problem descriptions. Support staff rely on the body content to understand the full scope of the issue and provide accurate solutions.

Body updates are permitted for clarification, additional context, or correction of information, but should preserve the original inquiry intent for audit trail purposes.

inquiry_type.description:
Category classification of the inquiry that determines routing and handling procedures within the support workflow.

Valid inquiry types include: product_question (general product information requests), order_issue (purchase or delivery problems), account_problem (authentication or access issues), technical_support (platform functionality problems), and general_feedback (suggestions or platform feedback).

Type changes may affect assignment to specialized support teams and should be validated against the inquiry's actual content to ensure appropriate routing.

priority.description:
Urgency level assignment that determines response time expectations and resource allocation for inquiry resolution.

Priority levels include: low (general questions with flexible timelines), medium (standard support requests), high (time-sensitive issues affecting user experience), and critical (system-wide problems requiring immediate attention).

Priority escalation or de-escalation should be justified by the current impact assessment and aligned with service level agreement commitments.

status.description:
Current workflow state tracking the inquiry's progression through the support lifecycle from submission to resolution.

Valid status transitions follow the workflow: open (newly submitted) → in_progress (actively being addressed) → awaiting_response (waiting for customer input) → resolved (issue addressed) → closed (finalized).

Status updates must follow logical progression rules and maintain workflow integrity, with appropriate validations for each transition to ensure proper support process adherence.

IShoppingMallInquiry.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for modifying existing customer support inquiries with comprehensive field-level update capabilities.

Contains optional fields that can be updated after inquiry creation, including title, detailed description, inquiry type classification, priority level assignment, and workflow status progression. All fields are optional to support partial updates that modify only specific aspects of the inquiry record.

This DTO is used by both customers (for updating their own inquiries with additional information or status changes) and administrators (for comprehensive inquiry management including priority escalation and status transitions). The update operation validates field changes against business rules and maintains audit trail integrity throughout the inquiry lifecycle.

Security considerations include ownership verification for customer updates and authorization checks for administrative modifications, ensuring proper access control based on user roles and inquiry ownership relationships.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the customer support inquiry that serves as the primary key for database operations and API endpoint references.

This UUID-based identifier ensures global uniqueness across all inquiry records and provides a stable reference for tracking inquiry progress, linking related support interactions, and maintaining audit trail consistency throughout the support lifecycle.

The ID is automatically generated upon inquiry creation and remains immutable throughout the inquiry's existence, providing a consistent reference point for all support operations and reporting activities.

title.description:
Brief summary of the inquiry issue or question that provides quick context for support staff when reviewing inquiry lists and search results.

The title serves as the primary identifier in list views, enabling quick scanning and categorization of multiple inquiries. It should be descriptive enough to convey the core issue while remaining concise for efficient display in summary interfaces.

Title content is indexed for search functionality and used for filtering and sorting operations in inquiry management dashboards and reporting systems.

body.description:
Detailed description of the inquiry including specific questions, issues, or requests for assistance that provides essential context even in summary views.

While summary views typically display truncated content, the body field inclusion ensures that key problem descriptions are available for quick assessment without requiring full detail navigation. This supports efficient triage and assignment decisions.

The body content in summary views may be truncated or excerpted for performance optimization while maintaining the core problem description for effective support workflow management.

inquiry_type.description:
Category classification of the inquiry that determines routing, handling procedures, and reporting categorization within the support system.

Inquiry types include: product_question (general product information), order_issue (purchase/delivery problems), account_problem (authentication/access issues), technical_support (platform functionality), and general_feedback (suggestions/feedback).

Type information enables efficient filtering, specialized team assignment, and category-based reporting for support performance analysis and resource allocation optimization.

priority.description:
Urgency level assignment that determines response time expectations, resource allocation, and escalation procedures for inquiry resolution.

Priority levels include: low (flexible timeline), medium (standard response), high (time-sensitive), and critical (immediate attention). This classification drives service level agreement compliance and support resource prioritization.

Priority display in summary views enables quick assessment of inquiry urgency and supports efficient workload distribution among support team members based on severity and expertise requirements.

status.description:
Current workflow state tracking the inquiry's progression through the support lifecycle from initial submission to final resolution.

Status values follow the workflow progression: open (new) → in_progress (active) → awaiting_response (pending) → resolved (addressed) → closed (finalized). This state tracking enables progress monitoring and workflow management.

Status information in summary views provides immediate visibility into inquiry progress, supports workload balancing, and enables performance metrics calculation for support team effectiveness assessment.

created_at.description:
Timestamp recording when the inquiry was initially submitted to the support system, providing chronological context for aging analysis and service level compliance tracking.

The creation timestamp enables calculation of inquiry age, response time metrics, and aging analysis for identifying potential bottlenecks in the support workflow. It serves as a baseline for service level agreement compliance monitoring.

In summary views, the creation date supports chronological sorting, aging-based prioritization, and temporal analysis of support request patterns for continuous improvement of support operations.

IShoppingMallInquiry.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of customer support inquiries optimized for list views, search results, and dashboard displays with comprehensive contextual information.

Provides essential inquiry metadata including identification, categorization, urgency assessment, and progress tracking while excluding complex relationships and extensive content details to optimize performance for high-volume list operations. The summary includes key problem description context to support efficient triage and assignment decisions without requiring navigation to full detail views.

Used extensively in customer support dashboards for quick status assessment, search result displays for efficient problem identification, and reporting systems for support performance analysis. The summary format balances information richness with performance considerations to support scalable support operations across the shopping mall platform.

Security considerations ensure that summary information is appropriately filtered based on user roles, with customers seeing only their own inquiries and administrators having access to comprehensive inquiry lists for effective support management and resource allocation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the support ticket record. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon ticket creation. Used as the primary key for database operations and API endpoint references.

ticket_number.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each support ticket for customer reference and internal tracking purposes. Provides human-readable identification for support staff and customers when referencing specific tickets. Format typically follows pattern like TKT-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for sequential tracking.

title.description: Brief summary capturing the core issue or problem description for quick identification and categorization. Should be concise yet descriptive enough to convey the ticket's primary concern without requiring full description review. Used for ticket list displays and search result summaries.

description.description: Comprehensive description of the customer issue including detailed symptoms, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and any relevant context. This field contains the complete problem narrative that support agents need to understand and resolve the issue effectively. Supports rich text formatting for structured problem documentation.

category.description: Ticket categorization that determines the appropriate support workflow and assignment routing. Common categories include technical_issue, billing_problem, account_security, product_question, and general_feedback. Category selection influences SLA timelines, agent expertise matching, and resolution procedures.

priority.description: Urgency level classification that determines response and resolution timelines according to service level agreements. Priority levels include low (standard response), medium (elevated attention), high (urgent resolution), and critical (immediate intervention). Higher priority tickets receive expedited handling and closer monitoring.

status.description: Current workflow state indicating the ticket's position in the support lifecycle. Valid states include new (unassigned), open (assigned but not started), in_progress (active resolution), resolved (solution applied), and closed (verified completion). Status transitions trigger notifications and workflow updates.

sla_deadline.description: Target resolution deadline calculated based on ticket priority and service level agreement commitments. Automatically set upon ticket creation and may be adjusted for priority escalations. Used for monitoring SLA compliance and triggering escalation procedures when deadlines approach.

resolution_notes.description: Documentation of the solution applied to resolve the ticket, including technical steps, customer communications, and any follow-up requirements. This field serves as the official resolution record for audit purposes and knowledge base contributions. Should include sufficient detail for future reference.

inquiry.description: Reference to the original customer inquiry that escalated to this formal support ticket. Provides context about the initial customer contact and problem reporting. Not all support tickets originate from inquiries - some may be created directly for complex issues requiring immediate formal tracking.

assigned_administrator.description: Support agent currently responsible for resolving this ticket. Assignment may change throughout the ticket lifecycle based on agent availability, expertise matching, or escalation procedures. Unassigned tickets remain in queue until manually assigned or automatically routed.

shopping_mall_inquiry_id.description: Foreign key reference to the original inquiry that escalated to this support ticket. Optional field that establishes the relationship between informal inquiries and formal support cases. When present, provides complete audit trail from initial customer contact to final resolution.

shopping_mall_administrator_id.description: Foreign key reference to the administrator assigned to handle this support ticket. Used for database relationship management and assignment tracking. May be null for unassigned tickets awaiting agent assignment.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the support ticket was initially created in the system. Used for reporting, aging analysis, and SLA calculation baselines. Automatically set upon ticket creation and remains immutable throughout the ticket lifecycle.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the ticket record. Updated automatically whenever any ticket field changes, providing accurate tracking of activity and modifications. Used for change monitoring and audit compliance.

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was marked as resolved with a working solution. Indicates when the primary issue was addressed, though verification and closure may follow. Used for resolution time metrics and performance reporting.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was formally closed after resolution verification and customer confirmation. Represents the final completion of the support case. Closed tickets remain accessible for historical reference but are excluded from active workload calculations.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was soft deleted for data retention or compliance purposes. Supports audit trail preservation while removing tickets from active operational views. Null for active tickets, populated upon deletion.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.description:
Formal support tickets for tracking complex customer issues requiring extended resolution processes.

Represents structured support cases that cannot be resolved through simple inquiry responses and require formal tracking, multiple interactions, and documented resolution procedures. Support tickets serve as the primary entity for managing complex customer issues throughout their complete lifecycle from creation to closure.

The system provides comprehensive tracking of issue details, agent assignments, SLA compliance monitoring, and resolution documentation. Tickets support various categorization schemes, priority levels, and workflow states to ensure appropriate handling based on issue severity and complexity.

Support tickets maintain relationships with customer inquiries (optional escalation source) and assigned administrators (resolution responsibility). The entity supports both automated workflow transitions and manual status management by support agents based on case progress and resolution requirements.

title.description: Brief summary capturing the core issue or problem description for quick identification and categorization. Should be concise yet descriptive enough to convey the ticket's primary concern without requiring full description review. Used for ticket list displays and search result summaries.

description.description: Comprehensive description of the customer issue including detailed symptoms, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and any relevant context. This field contains the complete problem narrative that support agents need to understand and resolve the issue effectively. Supports rich text formatting for structured problem documentation.

category.description: Ticket categorization that determines the appropriate support workflow and assignment routing. Common categories include technical_issue, billing_problem, account_security, product_question, and general_feedback. Category selection influences SLA timelines, agent expertise matching, and resolution procedures.

priority.description: Urgency level classification that determines response and resolution timelines according to service level agreements. Priority levels include low (standard response), medium (elevated attention), high (urgent resolution), and critical (immediate intervention). Higher priority tickets receive expedited handling and closer monitoring.

shopping_mall_inquiry_id.description: Optional reference to an existing customer inquiry that should be escalated to this formal support ticket. When provided, establishes a clear audit trail from initial customer contact to formal support case. Not required for tickets created directly for complex issues.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.ICreate.description:
Data structure for creating new support tickets to initiate formal tracking of complex customer issues.

Used when customer problems require extended resolution processes beyond simple inquiry responses. The system automatically generates unique ticket numbers, sets initial status to 'new', and calculates SLA deadlines based on priority levels. Administrator assignment is handled server-side based on authenticated admin context.

Required fields ensure comprehensive issue documentation including categorization and priority assessment for proper ticket routing. Optional inquiry reference allows escalation from existing customer inquiries to formal support cases when appropriate.

This DTO represents the minimum information needed to create a functional support ticket while allowing flexibility for different ticket creation scenarios including direct creation and inquiry escalation.

title.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue or problem description. Should be concise yet descriptive enough to identify the ticket's core issue. Maximum length should be limited to 255 characters for optimal display in management interfaces.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue including symptoms, steps to reproduce, and impact assessment. This field provides comprehensive context for support agents to understand and resolve the issue effectively. Should include all relevant technical details and customer-reported information.

category.description: Ticket categorization such as technical_issue, billing_problem, or account_security. Categories help route tickets to appropriate support teams and enable reporting by issue type. Valid categories should be predefined in the system configuration.

priority.description: Urgency level (low, medium, high, critical) determining response and resolution timelines. Critical priority tickets require immediate attention and may trigger escalation procedures. Priority levels should align with SLA requirements.

status.description: Current workflow state (new, open, in_progress, resolved, closed). Status transitions follow predefined workflows and may trigger notifications or automated actions. Only valid status transitions should be allowed based on business rules.

sla_deadline.description: Target resolution deadline based on service level agreements. SLA deadlines are calculated based on ticket priority and creation time. Missing SLA deadlines may trigger escalation and reporting requirements.

resolution_notes.description: Documentation of the solution applied to resolve the ticket. Should include detailed steps taken, root cause analysis, and any customer communications. Resolution notes are critical for knowledge base creation and future reference.

shopping_mall_inquiry_id.description: Original inquiry that escalated to a support ticket. References the shopping_mall_inquiries table and provides context for the ticket's origin. This field is optional as not all support tickets originate from customer inquiries.

shopping_mall_administrator_id.description: Support agent assigned to the ticket. References the shopping_mall_administrators table and enables ticket assignment tracking. Administrators can reassign tickets to different agents based on workload or expertise requirements.

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was marked as resolved. Resolution timestamp is used for SLA compliance tracking and performance reporting. Should be set automatically when status changes to resolved.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was formally closed after resolution verification. Closure timestamp indicates final completion of the support process. Should be set automatically when status changes to closed.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.IUpdate.description:
Data structure for updating existing support tickets with comprehensive field management capabilities.

Used when modifying ticket details, updating status, changing priority levels, assigning different agents, and adding resolution notes. All fields are optional to allow partial updates, enabling administrators to modify specific aspects of tickets without requiring complete record replacement.

Supports comprehensive ticket management throughout the support lifecycle including status transitions, SLA tracking, and resolution documentation. The update operation validates field constraints and ensures only authorized modifications are permitted based on administrator permissions and ticket workflow rules.

Field updates follow business logic constraints such as preventing status regression, enforcing SLA compliance, and maintaining audit trails for all changes. The operation integrates with notification systems to alert assigned agents of ticket modifications and status changes.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the support ticket record, generated automatically upon creation using UUID v4 format.

ticket_number.description: Unique ticket identifier for customer reference and support tracking. Ticket numbers follow a predefined format (e.g., TKT-YYYYMMDD-NNNN) for easy customer communication and internal reference.

title.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue or problem description. Provides quick context for support staff when reviewing ticket lists and enables efficient ticket identification and categorization.

category.description: Ticket categorization such as technical_issue, billing_problem, or account_security. Categories enable filtering, routing, and reporting by issue type, helping optimize support team efficiency and specialization.

priority.description: Urgency level (low, medium, high, critical) determining response and resolution timelines. Priority indicators help support agents prioritize their workload and ensure SLA compliance for time-sensitive issues.

status.description: Current workflow state (new, open, in_progress, resolved, closed). Status provides immediate visibility into ticket progress and helps managers monitor support team performance and workload distribution.

shopping_mall_inquiry_id.description: Original inquiry that escalated to this support ticket. Provides context for the ticket's origin and enables tracking of inquiry-to-ticket conversion rates and escalation patterns.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was created. Creation time is used for aging analysis, SLA calculation, and performance reporting across different time periods.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the ticket record. Update tracking helps monitor ticket activity levels and identify stalled or frequently modified tickets requiring attention.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary of support tickets optimized for list views, dashboard displays, and reporting interfaces.

Provides essential ticket information for quick reference and management interfaces while excluding detailed descriptions, resolution notes, and complex relationships to optimize performance for list operations. This summary representation balances information density with loading efficiency for high-volume ticket management scenarios.

Used in support agent dashboards, ticket management interfaces, summary reports, and search results where full ticket details are not required. The summary format enables efficient scanning, sorting, and filtering of large ticket volumes while maintaining critical context for decision-making and workflow management.

Performance considerations include minimizing data transfer size and database query complexity by focusing on indexed fields and frequently accessed properties. The summary excludes large text fields and complex object relationships that would degrade performance in list-oriented use cases.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Used for navigating through large datasets efficiently.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Controls the size of result sets returned by search operations.

search.description: Full-text search query for ticket titles and descriptions. Supports natural language search across ticket content.

category.description: Filter by specific ticket category such as technical_issue, billing_problem, or account_security. Matches the category field in the support ticket database.

priority.description: Filter by priority level (low, medium, high, critical). Determines urgency-based filtering for support ticket management.

status.description: Filter by current workflow state (new, open, in_progress, resolved, closed). Enables status-based ticket filtering.

assigned_administrator_id.description: Filter tickets assigned to a specific administrator. References the shopping_mall_administrators table for assignment tracking.

created_from.description: Filter tickets created after this date. Enables date range filtering for ticket creation timeline analysis.

created_to.description: Filter tickets created before this date. Provides upper bound for creation date range filtering.

oneOf.description: Sort by ticket creation timestamp for chronological ordering.
Sort by priority level for urgency-based organization.
Sort by service level agreement deadline for compliance tracking.
Sort by last modification timestamp for recent activity ordering.
Sort by unique ticket identifier for administrative reference.

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Determines the primary sorting criteria for ticket listings.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order for chronological or alphabetical ordering.
Descending sort order for reverse chronological or priority-based ordering.

order.description: Sort order (ascending or descending). Controls the direction of sorting operations.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering support tickets.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities for support ticket search operations across the shopping mall platform. Supports text search, category filtering, priority selection, status filtering, administrator assignment, date ranges, and multiple sorting options.

Used in administrative interfaces for efficient ticket management and search functionality. Pagination parameters ensure optimal performance with large datasets while maintaining comprehensive search capabilities for support workflow optimization.

IShoppingMallArticle.description:
Article entity representing content publications in the shopping mall platform.

Stores comprehensive article information including content, metadata, publication status, and engagement metrics. Articles support rich content formatting, categorization, and audience targeting for community engagement and informational purposes.

Each article maintains version history through snapshots, moderation workflows for content approval, and performance tracking through view counts, likes, and shares. Articles can be created by different actor types (customers, sellers, administrators) with proper ownership attribution and access controls based on actor_type field.

Provides complete article information including organizational context through channel and section references for atomic operation support. The entity supports featured positioning, comment controls, and publication timeline management for comprehensive content lifecycle handling.

Used in article creation, retrieval, update, and listing operations across customer, seller, and administrator interfaces with appropriate access controls and business logic validation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the article. Generated automatically upon creation using UUID v4 format for global uniqueness.

actor_type.description: Type of actor who created the article: customer, seller, administrator. Used for quick filtering and polymorphic ownership pattern implementation.

title.description: Article title displayed in listings and search results. Must be unique within the assigned channel for content organization.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle providing additional context for the article. Used for enhanced article previews and metadata display.

content.description: Full article content with rich text formatting support. Contains the complete article body with formatting, images, and embedded media.

summary.description: Brief summary or excerpt for article previews and metadata. Provides concise overview for search results and social sharing.

status.description: Publication status: draft, pending_review, published, or archived. Controls article visibility and access permissions.

business_status.description: Business workflow status for moderation and approval processes. Tracks internal approval workflows separate from publication status.

view_count.description: Total number of views for tracking article popularity and engagement metrics. Automatically incremented on each view.

like_count.description: Number of likes received for engagement tracking and content performance analysis. Managed through user interaction.

share_count.description: Number of times the article has been shared. Tracks social media and platform sharing activity.

featured.description: Indicates if the article is featured in prominent positions. Featured articles receive priority display in listings.

allow_comments.description: Controls whether comments are allowed on this article. Enables/disables community engagement features.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the article was published to the public. Null for draft articles, populated upon publication.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was initially created. Records the original creation time for version tracking.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified. Tracks all content and metadata updates.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the article was soft deleted for moderation. Enables content recovery and audit trail maintenance.

channel.description: Content channel where this article is published. Provides organizational context for article placement within the shopping mall content hierarchy.

section.description: Section within the channel for content organization. Optional contextual information for hierarchical content structuring.

IShoppingMallArticle.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for retrieving shopping mall articles with advanced search capabilities.

Supports comprehensive filtering including publication status, business workflow status, engagement metrics, and organizational context. The search system leverages PostgreSQL GIN indexes on title and content fields for efficient full-text search with relevance ranking.

Users can filter by actor type (customer, seller, administrator) for content attribution, publication status (draft, pending_review, published, archived), business workflow status, featured status, comment permissions, and engagement metrics ranges. The system supports date-based filtering for publication timelines and organizational filtering through channel and section hierarchies.

Pagination parameters ensure efficient data retrieval for list displays while maintaining performance with large article collections. Sorting capabilities allow ordering by creation date, update date, publication date, or engagement metrics in ascending or descending order.

Used for article search operations that return paginated summary information optimized for list views with essential metadata and organizational context.

Security Note: This request DTO supports filtering by actor type and publication status to enable appropriate content access controls based on user permissions and content visibility settings.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starting from 1). Required for efficient data retrieval and navigation through large article collections.

limit.description: Number of articles per page for pagination. Controls result set size for optimal performance and user experience.

search.description: Full-text search query for title and content matching using PostgreSQL GIN indexes. Supports complex boolean search patterns and relevance ranking.

actor_type.description: Filter by actor type who created the article: customer, seller, administrator. Enables content attribution filtering and ownership-based access controls.

status.description: Filter by publication status: draft, pending_review, published, archived. Controls content visibility based on publication workflow.

business_status.description: Filter by business workflow status for moderation processes. Supports custom business logic filtering for content approval workflows.

featured.description: Filter for featured articles only. Identifies content marked for prominent display positions.

allow_comments.description: Filter by comment permission setting. Controls whether articles allow user engagement through comments.

view_count_min.description: Minimum view count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified minimum visibility.

view_count_max.description: Maximum view count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified maximum visibility.

like_count_min.description: Minimum like count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified minimum user approval.

like_count_max.description: Maximum like count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified maximum user approval.

share_count_min.description: Minimum share count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified minimum virality.

share_count_max.description: Maximum share count filter for engagement-based filtering. Identifies articles with specified maximum virality.

channel_id.description: Filter by specific content channel UUID reference. Enables organizational filtering through channel hierarchy.

section_id.description: Filter by specific section UUID reference within a channel. Provides granular content categorization filtering.

published_after.description: Filter articles published after this timestamp. Supports temporal filtering for content freshness.

published_before.description: Filter articles published before this timestamp. Supports historical content filtering.

sort_by.description: Sort field: created_at, updated_at, published_at, view_count, like_count, share_count. Controls result ordering for optimal display.

order.description: Sort order: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Controls direction of result ordering.

IShoppingMallArticle.ICreate.description:
Article creation data structure for adding new content to the platform with comprehensive content management capabilities.

Contains all required article information for content creation including title, content, publication settings, and organizational context. The creation process initiates automated moderation workflows based on actor type, content guidelines, and channel-specific publication requirements.

The system supports rich content formatting with comprehensive metadata including optional subtitles, summaries, and categorization through channel and section assignments. Content undergoes quality validation checks before publication and supports polymorphic ownership attribution through the actor_type field.

Business logic workflows automatically set appropriate status flags, engagement metrics defaults, and timestamp values based on the creation context. The system validates channel accessibility and section assignments to ensure proper content organization and visibility controls.

Used for article creation operations across different actor types (customers, sellers, administrators) with appropriate access controls and content moderation workflows based on the creating user's permissions and the target channel's configuration.

Security Note: This creation DTO requires authentication and authorization checks to ensure users can create articles in their assigned channels with appropriate content moderation workflows based on actor type and channel permissions.

actor_type.description: Type of actor creating the article: customer, seller, administrator. Required for polymorphic ownership attribution and access control enforcement.

title.description: Article title for display, search optimization, and content identification. Must meet platform content guidelines and length requirements.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle providing additional context and content summary. Supports enhanced content presentation and user engagement.

content.description: Full article content with rich text formatting support. Must contain substantive content meeting platform quality standards and moderation requirements.

summary.description: Optional brief summary for article previews and metadata. Provides concise content overview for list displays and search results.

featured.description: Whether the article should be featured in prominent display positions. Requires appropriate permissions based on actor type and channel settings.

allow_comments.description: Whether comments should be allowed on the article. Controls user engagement capabilities and moderation requirements.

channel_id.description: Content channel UUID where the article will be published. Required for proper content organization and visibility controls.

section_id.description: Optional section UUID within the channel for granular content organization. Provides additional categorization for content discovery.

IShoppingMallArticle.IUpdate.description:
Article update data structure for modifying existing article content and properties.

Allows content authors to update article text, metadata, publication settings, and organizational relationships while maintaining version history and engagement metrics. Significant changes may require re-moderation.

The update operation preserves article integrity while supporting content improvements, corrections, feature updates, and organizational changes. Supports partial updates where only specified fields are modified while preserving unchanged fields.

Channel and section references use proper foreign key relationships with existing database fields. Status updates follow proper workflow transitions with business logic validation.

Security Note: This DTO contains only business data fields. Authentication context (actor identity) is managed server-side from verified JWT tokens, not accepted from client requests to prevent impersonation attacks.

title.description: Updated article title for display purposes. Must be between 1 and 255 characters. Used for article identification in listings and search results.

subtitle.description: Updated article subtitle providing additional context and information. Optional field with maximum length of 500 characters for enhanced article presentation.

content.description: Updated article content with current information and rich text formatting support. Must contain meaningful content for user consumption and engagement.

summary.description: Updated article summary for previews and metadata purposes. Optional field providing concise overview of article content for quick reference.

status.description: Updated publication status: draft, pending_review, published, or archived. Status transitions follow business workflow rules and require proper authorization.

business_status.description: Updated business workflow status for moderation and approval processes. Managed according to platform policies and content guidelines.

featured.description: Updated featured status for prominence in content listings. Only administrators can modify featured status for security and content quality reasons.

allow_comments.description: Updated comment permission setting controlling user interaction. Determines whether users can comment on this article for community engagement.

IShoppingMallArticle.ISummary.description:
Compact article representation for list views and search results with complete contextual information.

Provides essential article information for efficient display in content lists, search results, and reference contexts. The summary format optimizes performance while maintaining key article details and organizational relationships.

Includes channel and section context for proper content categorization and navigation. Used in article listings, content feeds, and quick reference scenarios where full article content is not required but organizational context is essential.

Maintains circular reference prevention by using .ISummary types for all reference relationships while providing complete information for display and navigation purposes.

Security Note: This response DTO excludes sensitive system fields and authentication context to prevent data exposure. Only public-facing article information is included for display purposes.

id.description: Unique article identifier for secure reference and database operations. System-generated UUID ensuring global uniqueness and security.

title.description: Article title for identification and user display. Public-facing content suitable for user consumption in listings and search results.

subtitle.description: Article subtitle providing additional context and information. Optional field enhancing article presentation in summary views.

summary.description: Brief summary for article preview and context. Provides users with article overview without full content exposure for efficient browsing.

status.description: Publication status indicating article visibility and workflow state. Shows whether article is draft, pending review, published, or archived.

business_status.description: Business workflow status for moderation and approval tracking. Indicates current position in content review and publication process.

featured.description: Featured status indicating article prominence in content listings. Shows whether article receives special placement for increased visibility.

allow_comments.description: Comment permission setting controlling user interaction. Indicates whether users can engage with the article through comments.

view_count.description: View count for popularity indication and engagement tracking. Public metric showing article reach and user interest levels.

published_at.description: Publication date for temporal context and content freshness. Shows when article was made available to users in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp showing when article was initially created. Provides content lifecycle information for administrative purposes.

updated_at.description: Modification timestamp indicating last update activity. Shows when article content or metadata was last changed.

channel.description: Channel context for organizational placement and navigation. Provides content categorization information for proper content discovery.

section.description: Section context for content categorization and filtering. Optional organizational information for hierarchical content browsing.

IShoppingMallArticleComment.description:
User comments on shopping mall articles for community engagement with proper actor attribution and threaded discussion support.

Stores comprehensive comment information including content, engagement metrics, moderation status, and hierarchical relationships. Comments support threaded discussions through parent-child relationships and maintain independent lifecycles from parent articles for cross-platform search and moderation workflows.

The system tracks engagement metrics like likes and reports, supports content moderation workflows with status tracking, and maintains hierarchical organization through depth tracking. Each comment is associated with its parent article and optionally with a parent comment for threaded discussions.

Security considerations include proper actor attribution through actor_type field, protection of system-managed timestamps, and authentication context boundaries for ownership verification. Comments undergo moderation workflows before public display and support community engagement features.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the comment record. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format for secure identification and database integrity.

Used as the primary key for comment operations and foreign key references in related entities. Provides unique identification across the entire comment system for reliable data relationships.

content.description:
Comment text content with support for basic formatting and rich text capabilities.

Contains the user-generated comment text that appears in article discussions. Supports basic formatting like line breaks and paragraphs, with content moderation applied for inappropriate language detection.

Maximum length restrictions apply to prevent spam comments while allowing meaningful discussion contributions. Content validation ensures compliance with platform content guidelines.

oneOf.description:
Moderation status indicating the current state of the comment in the approval workflow.

Defines the comment's visibility and moderation state: pending (awaiting review), approved (visible to users), rejected (removed by moderators), or flagged (reported for review).

Moderators can change status based on content guidelines, while automated systems may flag comments for manual review based on reporting thresholds.

Moderation status indicating the current state of the comment in the approval workflow.

Defines the comment's visibility and moderation state: pending (awaiting review), approved (visible to users), rejected (removed by moderators), or flagged (reported for review).

Moderators can change status based on content guidelines, while automated systems may flag comments for manual review based on reporting thresholds.

Moderation status indicating the current state of the comment in the approval workflow.

Defines the comment's visibility and moderation state: pending (awaiting review), approved (visible to users), rejected (removed by moderators), or flagged (reported for review).

Helpful count updates are typically managed automatically by user interactions but can be adjusted for moderation or system correction needs.

report_count.description:
Updated count of times this review has been reported. Supports moderation workflow adjustments and content flag management.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the review was soft deleted. Supports restoration workflows and content moderation processes.

IShoppingMallReview.IUpdate.description:
Data structure for updating existing review entities in the shopping mall system.

Supports selective field updates while preserving system-managed attributes and ownership relationships. Validates that updates maintain data integrity and comply with platform content standards. The update process automatically refreshes the updated_at timestamp while preserving creation metadata.

Security considerations prevent modification of ownership fields and system-generated identifiers. Actor identity remains unchanged from the original creation context. The structure supports flexible review editing workflows while maintaining audit trails and moderation controls.

Rating constraints ensure valid evaluation scores while protecting against invalid input during updates. Status field updates enable comprehensive review moderation workflows while maintaining platform content standards.

id.description:
Primary Key. Unique identifier for the review entity used for database operations and API references.

The review ID provides a stable reference point for all review-related operations and maintains referential integrity across the platform.

actor_type.description:
Type of actor who created the review: customer, seller. Identifies the origin of the review for proper context and filtering.

Actor type classification enables proper review attribution and supports platform features like seller response workflows and customer review filtering.

title.description:
Review title summarizing the evaluation. Provides a concise overview of the review content for quick scanning.

The title serves as the primary identifier in list views and search results, helping users quickly assess review relevance and content focus.

overall_rating.description:
Overall rating score from 1.0 to 5.0. Represents the quantitative assessment of the product or service.

Rating scores provide immediate visual feedback in list views and support sorting and filtering operations based on review quality.

oneOf.description:
Review status: pending, approved, rejected, flagged. Indicates the current state in the review moderation workflow.

helpful_count.description:
Number of users who found this review helpful. Measures review usefulness and community validation.

Helpful count serves as a social validation metric, helping users identify high-quality reviews based on community feedback.

verified_purchase.description:
Indicates if the reviewer made a verified purchase. Establishes review authenticity and credibility.

updated_at.description:
