Represents the mean transaction value for purchases involving products from this category, providing insights into customer spending patterns and category profitability. Used for revenue forecasting and pricing strategy optimization.

Higher average values may indicate premium product categories or customer segments with greater purchasing power, while lower values might suggest budget-conscious shopping or impulse purchase categories.

The metric considers both the quantity and pricing of products purchased, offering a comprehensive view of category performance from both volume and value perspectives for strategic business planning.

basket_size_distribution.description:
Detailed distribution analysis of basket sizes within the specified category or segment.

Provides a comprehensive breakdown of how basket sizes are distributed across different value ranges and item counts, offering granular insights into purchasing behavior patterns beyond simple averages.

The distribution analysis helps identify common basket size patterns, outliers, and opportunities for optimization. For example, it might reveal that most baskets fall into a specific size range, suggesting targeted marketing opportunities.

Used by category managers and merchandising teams to understand customer purchasing habits, optimize product assortments, and develop targeted strategies to increase basket sizes through complementary product placement and promotional incentives.

IRetentionRatePeriod.description:
Retention rate at a specific time interval after customer acquisition.

This schema represents the customer retention rate at a particular time period after customers were initially acquired. Period-based retention analysis helps understand how customer loyalty evolves over time and identifies critical retention periods where interventions are most effective.

The analysis provides insights into customer lifecycle patterns and helps optimize timing for retention interventions, loyalty program enhancements, and customer engagement strategies. Retention rates are calculated as the percentage of customers who remain active at each specified period after their initial acquisition.

Used primarily in customer analytics dashboards and retention reporting to track cohort performance over time and measure the effectiveness of customer retention initiatives.

period_after_acquisition.description:
Time period after customer acquisition expressed in standardized format (e.g., '30 days', '90 days', '1 year', '2 years').

This field specifies the exact time interval being measured for retention analysis. Standardized period formats ensure consistency across different analytics reports and enable comparative analysis between different customer cohorts.

Examples include: '7 days' for weekly retention, '30 days' for monthly retention, '90 days' for quarterly retention, and '365 days' for annual retention analysis.

retention_rate.description:
Retention rate percentage at this specific period, calculated as the proportion of customers remaining active.

Expressed as a percentage value between 0 and 100, representing the fraction of the original customer cohort that remains active at the specified period. A retention rate of 75% indicates that 75% of customers acquired during the initial period are still active customers.

This metric is crucial for understanding customer loyalty patterns and identifying optimal intervention points for retention strategies. Higher retention rates indicate better customer satisfaction and product-market fit.

cohort_size.description:
Number of customers remaining in the cohort at this specific period after acquisition.

Represents the actual count of customers who have remained active through the specified period. This absolute number provides context for the retention rate percentage and helps assess the statistical significance of the retention analysis.

Larger cohort sizes provide more reliable retention metrics, while smaller cohort sizes may indicate the need for longer observation periods or combined cohort analysis for statistical validity.

IChurnBySegment.description:
Churn rate analysis for a specific customer segment.

This schema provides detailed churn analysis for a particular customer segment, helping identify which segments are most at risk and why. Segment-based churn analysis enables targeted retention strategies by understanding the unique characteristics and behaviors of different customer groups.

The analysis includes segment-specific churn rates, cohort sizes, and primary contributing factors. This granular approach allows for more effective customer retention interventions by addressing segment-specific pain points and optimizing resource allocation for retention efforts.

Used in customer segmentation analytics, churn prediction models, and targeted retention campaign planning to reduce overall customer attrition and improve lifetime value.

segment_name.description:
Name or identifier of the customer segment being analyzed for churn patterns.

This field identifies the specific customer segment category, such as 'high-value customers', 'new customers', 'geographic region', 'product category users', or other segmentation criteria.

Clear segment naming enables effective communication of churn analysis results and facilitates targeted retention strategies. Examples include: 'premium subscribers', 'enterprise customers', 'North America region', or 'mobile app users'.

segment_churn_rate.description:
Churn rate percentage for this specific customer segment, calculated as the proportion of customers who have discontinued service.

Expressed as a percentage value between 0 and 100, representing the fraction of customers within the segment who have churned during the analysis period. A churn rate of 15% indicates that 15% of customers in this segment have stopped using the service.

This segment-specific churn rate helps identify high-risk customer groups and prioritize retention efforts based on actual churn patterns and business impact.

segment_size.description:
Total number of customers in this specific segment during the analysis period.

Represents the size of the customer segment being analyzed, providing context for the churn rate percentage. Larger segment sizes generally provide more statistically significant churn analysis results.

This metric helps assess the business impact of churn within the segment and guides resource allocation for retention initiatives based on segment importance and size.

primary_churn_factors.description:
Primary factors identified as contributing to churn within this specific customer segment.

This array contains the key reasons or patterns identified as driving churn within the segment. Common factors include: 'price sensitivity', 'product complexity', 'competitor offerings', 'customer service issues', 'feature limitations', or 'usage patterns'.

Understanding these factors enables targeted interventions, such as product improvements, pricing adjustments, or enhanced customer support, specifically designed to address the unique churn drivers within each segment.

IChurnIndicator.description:
Key indicator that predicts potential customer churn based on behavioral, demographic, engagement, or purchase patterns.

Churn indicators are statistical models that identify customers at risk of leaving the platform based on specific metrics and thresholds. These indicators enable proactive retention efforts by flagging customers who exhibit behaviors correlated with churn.

Each indicator includes the specific metric type, threshold values that signal risk, and the predictive strength calculated through statistical analysis. Indicators are used in customer analytics dashboards and automated retention workflows.

The schema supports multiple metric types including behavioral patterns, demographic characteristics, engagement levels, and purchase history to provide comprehensive churn prediction capabilities.

indicator_name.description:
Unique name identifying the churn prediction indicator for reference and tracking purposes. Must be descriptive enough to convey the specific metric being measured, such as 'login_frequency_decline' or 'purchase_value_drop'.

Used in analytics dashboards and reporting systems to identify which specific indicators are triggering churn alerts.

oneOf.description: Behavioral metric tracking customer actions and usage patterns over time, such as login frequency, session duration, or feature usage trends.
Demographic metric based on customer characteristics like age, location, or account tenure that correlate with churn probability.
Engagement metric measuring customer interaction levels with platform features, notifications, or community activities.
Purchase metric analyzing transaction patterns, order frequency, basket size, or spending trends that indicate churn risk.

metric_type.description:
Categorical classification of the metric type used for churn prediction, determining how the indicator data is collected and analyzed.

Each metric type requires different data sources and analysis methods, with behavioral metrics focusing on usage patterns and demographic metrics leveraging customer profile information.

risk_threshold.description:
Numerical threshold value that indicates elevated churn risk when exceeded or unmet, depending on the indicator direction.

For example, a login frequency indicator might trigger at less than 2 logins per week, while a purchase value indicator might trigger at spending below $50 per month.

Threshold values are calibrated through historical data analysis to balance detection sensitivity with false positive rates.

predictive_strength.description:
Statistical measure indicating how strongly this indicator correlates with actual churn events, typically expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

Values closer to 1 indicate stronger predictive power, while values near 0 suggest weak correlation. This metric helps prioritize which indicators to focus on for retention efforts.

Calculated through regression analysis or machine learning models using historical customer data.

ISizeDistribution.description:
Comprehensive distribution analysis of shopping basket sizes across different customer segments, product categories, or time periods.

This schema provides detailed statistical breakdowns of how basket sizes are distributed within the shopping platform, showing patterns in customer purchasing behavior. Distribution analysis helps merchants understand typical purchase volumes and identify opportunities for basket size optimization.

The analysis supports strategic decisions including inventory planning, pricing strategies, promotional targeting, and customer segmentation based on purchasing patterns. Retailers can identify whether their customer base tends toward small frequent purchases or larger consolidated orders.

Size distribution data is essential for optimizing shipping strategies, warehouse management, and product bundling opportunities to increase average order value and customer satisfaction.

size_range.description:
Categorical classification of basket size ranges for segmentation and analysis purposes, such as 'small' (1-3 items), 'medium' (4-7 items), or 'large' (8+ items).

Size ranges are configurable based on business requirements and can be adjusted to match specific product categories or customer segments. The categorization enables simplified reporting and trend analysis across different basket size groups.

item_count_range.description:
Numerical range specifying the minimum and maximum number of items included in baskets within this size category.

Provides precise boundaries for basket size classification, enabling accurate filtering and segmentation. For example, a 'medium' basket might be defined as containing 4 to 7 items inclusive.

The range boundaries are used in analytics calculations to determine which baskets fall into each size category for distribution percentage calculations.

value_range.description:
Monetary value range representing the total spending amount for baskets within this size category, typically in the platform's base currency.

Helps correlate basket size with customer spending patterns, revealing whether larger baskets correspond to higher total values or if customers are purchasing lower-priced items in quantity.

Value ranges are essential for financial analysis, revenue forecasting, and understanding the relationship between basket composition and total order value.

percentage_of_baskets.description:
Percentage value indicating what proportion of total baskets fall into this specific size category during the analyzed period.

Calculated as (number of baskets in category / total baskets) × 100%. This metric helps merchants understand the distribution of basket sizes across their customer base.

High percentages in smaller basket categories may indicate opportunity for cross-selling, while concentration in larger baskets suggests successful bundling strategies.

IShoppingMallDashboardOverview.description:
Comprehensive dashboard overview statistics for the shopping mall platform.

This schema represents aggregated business metrics and system statistics for administrative oversight and business intelligence. It includes key performance indicators across sales, customer engagement, product inventory, and platform activity, providing administrators with a holistic view of platform performance.

The overview aggregates data from multiple Prisma schema tables including shopping_mall_sales, shopping_mall_customers, shopping_mall_products, and shopping_mall_orders. Metrics include total sales revenue, customer growth trends, product inventory status, and order processing statistics. This dashboard data is generated in real-time through aggregation queries without storing pre-computed values, ensuring data freshness and accuracy for administrative decision-making purposes.

Used exclusively in the dashboard overview endpoint for administrative monitoring and business intelligence reporting. The schema provides both high-level summary metrics and detailed breakdowns for deeper analysis of platform performance trends.

totalSales.description:
Total sales revenue generated across all completed transactions in the platform.

Represents the cumulative revenue from all successfully processed sales transactions. This value is calculated by summing the sale_amount field from shopping_mall_sales records where sale_status equals 'completed'. Includes both product sales and any applicable taxes or service fees.

This metric serves as the primary indicator of platform revenue performance and is used for financial reporting, trend analysis, and business growth assessment. The value is updated in real-time as new sales are completed.

totalCustomers.description:
Total number of registered customers in the platform.

Counts all active customer accounts that have completed registration and are eligible to make purchases. This metric is derived from the shopping_mall_customers table, filtering for records where status equals 'active'.

Provides insight into platform adoption and customer base growth. This count excludes suspended, deleted, or inactive customer accounts to ensure accurate representation of the active user base.

totalProducts.description:
Total number of active products available for sale.

Represents the current inventory of products that customers can purchase. This count includes all products from shopping_mall_products where status equals 'active', excluding discontinued, out-of-stock, or temporarily unavailable items.

This metric helps administrators monitor product catalog size and inventory management effectiveness. It reflects the breadth of shopping options available to customers at any given time.

totalOrders.description:
Total number of orders placed in the system.

Counts all purchase orders created by customers, regardless of their current status. This includes orders in various states such as pending, processing, shipped, completed, or cancelled.

Provides a comprehensive view of customer purchasing activity and order volume. This metric helps track platform transaction volume and customer engagement levels over time.

salesToday.description:
Sales revenue generated today.

Aggregates sale_amount from shopping_mall_sales where sale_date matches the current date and sale_status is 'completed'. This provides a daily performance snapshot for quick assessment of today's business activity.

Used for daily revenue tracking and same-day performance comparison. The calculation excludes sales from previous days and includes only transactions finalized on the current date.

newCustomersToday.description:
Number of new customer registrations today.

Counts customer accounts created today from shopping_mall_customers where created_at date matches the current date. This metric tracks daily customer acquisition and platform growth.

Helps administrators monitor registration trends and marketing effectiveness. Only includes customers who completed the registration process successfully on the current day.

ordersToday.description:
Number of orders placed today.

Counts orders created today from shopping_mall_orders where created_at date matches the current date. This provides insight into daily purchasing activity and customer engagement.

This metric helps track order volume fluctuations and identify peak shopping periods. Includes all orders regardless of their current processing status.

averageOrderValue.description:
Average value of completed orders.

Calculated as totalSales divided by totalOrders, providing the mean transaction value across all customer purchases. This metric helps understand customer spending patterns and pricing effectiveness.

Used for revenue optimization and customer behavior analysis. The calculation includes only completed orders to ensure accurate representation of actual revenue per transaction.

topSellingCategories.description:
Top selling product categories by sales volume.

Provides a ranked list of product categories based on sales performance, helping administrators identify market trends and popular product segments.

Each entry includes detailed sales metrics for individual categories, allowing for targeted analysis of category performance and revenue contribution.

recentSales.description:
Most recent sales transactions for quick review.

Displays the latest completed sales transactions with essential details including customer information, product details, and transaction amounts.

Enables administrators to monitor recent platform activity, verify transaction processing, and identify any unusual patterns or trends in real-time.

platformMetrics.description:
Additional platform-level metrics and statistics.

Contains supplementary performance indicators that provide deeper insights into platform health, user engagement, and operational efficiency.

Includes conversion rates, customer retention metrics, inventory turnover, and other business intelligence indicators that support comprehensive platform assessment.

ICategorySalesSummary.description:
Sales summary for a specific product category.

Provides aggregated sales data for individual product categories, showing performance metrics and revenue contribution. This helps administrators identify top-performing categories and market trends for strategic business decisions.

Each summary includes comprehensive metrics including category identification, total sales revenue, transaction volume, and average sale value. This data is essential for category performance analysis, inventory planning, and marketing strategy development.

The schema supports comparative analysis across different product categories, enabling administrators to allocate resources effectively and optimize product assortment based on actual sales performance and customer demand patterns.

categoryId.description:
Unique identifier of the product category from shopping_mall_categories.

References the specific category record in the database, ensuring accurate tracking and reporting of category-specific performance metrics.

This identifier is used to link category sales data with category properties and hierarchical relationships within the product catalog structure.

categoryName.description:
Name of the product category for display purposes.

Provides the human-readable category name that appears in user interfaces and reports. This field ensures clear identification of the category being analyzed.

The category name is sourced from the shopping_mall_categories table and reflects the organizational structure of the product catalog.

totalSales.description:
Total sales revenue generated from products in this category.

Represents the cumulative revenue attributed to this specific product category. Calculated by summing sale_amount values from shopping_mall_sales where the sold products belong to this category.

This metric is crucial for understanding category revenue contribution and identifying high-performing product segments within the overall product assortment.

transactionCount.description:
Number of sales transactions involving products from this category.

Counts the total number of completed sales transactions that include at least one product from this category. This provides insight into category popularity and customer purchase frequency.

Helps administrators understand category engagement levels and identify categories with high transaction volume but potentially lower average transaction values.

averageSaleValue.description:
Average value of sales transactions for this category.

Calculated as totalSales divided by transactionCount, providing the mean transaction value specifically for this product category. This metric helps assess category pricing strategy and customer spending patterns.

Used for category performance benchmarking and pricing optimization. Categories with higher average sale values may indicate premium positioning or successful upselling strategies.

IRecentSale.description:
Recent sales transaction details for dashboard display and business intelligence reporting.

Provides comprehensive information about recent sales transactions including customer details, product information, financial metrics, and transaction timing. This allows administrators to monitor recent platform activity, identify sales trends, and make data-driven business decisions.

Each recent sale includes complete transaction details from the shopping_mall_sales table, linking customer identification, product information, sale amounts, commission calculations, and transaction timestamps. These records are essential for real-time business monitoring and performance analysis.

The schema represents finalized sales transactions that have been successfully processed and paid, providing accurate financial data for reporting and analytics purposes. Recent sales data helps identify popular products, customer purchasing patterns, and platform revenue performance.

Used primarily for administrative dashboard displays, sales reporting, and business intelligence applications where quick access to recent transaction data is required for operational decision-making.

saleId.description:
Unique identifier of the sale transaction from shopping_mall_sales table.

This UUID serves as the primary key for identifying individual sales records and provides a unique reference for tracking transaction history, customer service inquiries, and financial reconciliation processes.

The sale ID links directly to the original order that generated this sale, enabling comprehensive transaction tracing and audit trail maintenance for compliance and reporting requirements.

customerName.description:
Full name of the customer who made the purchase, combining first and last name from customer records.

Provides personal identification for customer service and relationship management purposes while maintaining data privacy by not exposing sensitive customer information like email addresses or phone numbers.

The customer name helps administrators quickly identify purchasing patterns and provides context for customer support interactions when reviewing recent sales activity.

productName.description:
Name of the product sold in this transaction as displayed in the product catalog.

Represents the specific item purchased by the customer, providing context for sales analysis, inventory management, and product performance tracking across the platform.

Product names help identify popular items, seasonal trends, and customer preferences, supporting merchandising decisions and inventory planning based on actual sales data.

saleAmount.description:
Total sale amount including taxes, shipping costs, and any applicable fees.

Represents the gross revenue generated from this transaction before platform commissions and seller payouts. This amount reflects the total customer payment for the purchase.

The sale amount is essential for revenue tracking, financial reporting, and calculating platform performance metrics such as average order value and total sales volume.

saleDate.description:
Timestamp when the sale was finalized and recorded in the system.

Indicates the exact date and time the transaction was completed, providing chronological context for sales analysis, trend identification, and performance reporting over specific time periods.

Sale dates enable time-based analysis of sales patterns, seasonal trends, and platform performance metrics, supporting data-driven business decisions and strategic planning.

itemCount.description:
Total number of items sold in this transaction, representing the quantity purchased.

Indicates the volume of products included in the sale, which helps analyze customer purchasing behavior, basket sizes, and product popularity across different transaction types.

Item count data supports inventory management, shipping cost calculations, and customer behavior analysis by providing insights into typical order sizes and product bundling patterns.

saleStatus.description:
Current status of the sale transaction: completed, refunded, disputed, or other status values.

Provides real-time visibility into transaction state, enabling administrators to monitor sales health, identify issues requiring attention, and track resolution progress for problematic transactions.

Status tracking ensures accurate financial reporting and helps maintain platform integrity by identifying and addressing transaction anomalies or customer disputes promptly.

commissionRate.description:
Platform commission percentage applied to this sale for revenue sharing.

Represents the platform's fee structure for facilitating the transaction, calculated as a percentage of the sale amount. This rate determines the platform's revenue share from each transaction.

Commission rates support financial planning, partner relationship management, and platform sustainability by ensuring appropriate revenue distribution between the platform and sellers.

netAmount.description:
Final amount after commission and fees for seller payout, representing the seller's net revenue.

Calculated as the sale amount minus platform commissions and any applicable transaction fees. This amount represents what the seller actually receives from the transaction.

Net amount tracking ensures accurate financial settlements, supports seller trust and satisfaction, and provides transparency in the revenue sharing model between platform and merchants.

IPlatformMetrics.description:
Comprehensive platform-level metrics and statistics for business intelligence and performance monitoring.

Provides detailed insights into platform performance, user engagement, financial health, and operational efficiency through a comprehensive set of calculated metrics. These indicators support data-driven decision making and strategic planning for platform growth and optimization.

Includes conversion rates, customer retention metrics, inventory turnover, response times, and other key performance indicators that collectively paint a complete picture of platform health and user satisfaction. Each metric is calculated using real-time data from platform operations.

These metrics enable administrators to identify trends, monitor platform stability, optimize user experience, and make informed decisions about feature development, marketing strategies, and resource allocation based on actual performance data.

Used for executive dashboards, performance reporting, investor communications, and strategic planning where comprehensive platform intelligence is required for effective business management and growth optimization.

conversionRate.description:
Platform conversion rate calculated as totalOrders divided by totalCustomers, representing the percentage of registered customers who make purchases.

This critical metric measures the platform's effectiveness at converting registered users into paying customers. A higher conversion rate indicates better user experience, effective marketing, and strong product-market fit.

Conversion rate analysis helps identify opportunities for improvement in user onboarding, product discovery, checkout processes, and overall platform usability that can drive increased revenue generation.

customerRetentionRate.description:
Percentage of customers who have made multiple purchases, indicating customer loyalty and platform stickiness.

Measures the platform's ability to retain customers and encourage repeat business, which is essential for sustainable growth and reduced customer acquisition costs. Higher retention rates indicate strong customer satisfaction and platform value.

Retention analysis supports customer lifecycle management, loyalty program effectiveness, and helps identify factors that contribute to long-term customer relationships and recurring revenue streams.

inventoryTurnover.description:
Inventory turnover rate indicating how quickly products are selling relative to available stock levels.

Calculated as the ratio of cost of goods sold to average inventory, this metric helps optimize inventory management, reduce carrying costs, and improve cash flow by ensuring products move efficiently through the sales pipeline.

Inventory turnover analysis supports purchasing decisions, identifies slow-moving products, and helps maintain optimal stock levels to meet customer demand while minimizing excess inventory and associated costs.

averageResponseTime.description:
Average response time for customer inquiries and support requests measured in seconds or minutes.

Indicates the platform's responsiveness to customer needs and support efficiency. Faster response times correlate with higher customer satisfaction and better issue resolution outcomes.

Response time monitoring helps optimize support operations, identify bottlenecks in customer service processes, and ensure timely assistance for users experiencing issues with the platform.

totalOrders.description:
Total number of orders processed through the platform during the reporting period.

Provides a fundamental measure of platform transaction volume and business activity. Tracking order counts helps monitor growth trends, seasonal patterns, and overall platform usage intensity.

Order volume analysis supports capacity planning, resource allocation, and helps identify periods of high demand that may require additional operational support or infrastructure scaling.

totalCustomers.description:
Total number of registered customers with active accounts on the platform.

Represents the platform's customer base size and market reach. Customer count growth indicates successful user acquisition strategies and platform adoption rates.

Customer base analysis supports marketing effectiveness evaluation, helps forecast revenue potential, and provides context for other metrics like conversion rates and average order values.

activeSellers.description:
Number of sellers actively listing products and processing orders on the platform.

Indicates the health and diversity of the seller ecosystem, which directly impacts product variety, competitive pricing, and overall platform attractiveness to customers.

Active seller tracking helps assess marketplace vitality, supports seller relationship management, and identifies opportunities for seller recruitment and support programs.

averageOrderValue.description:
Average monetary value of orders placed on the platform, calculated as total revenue divided by total orders.

Provides insights into customer spending patterns and transaction economics. Higher average order values indicate stronger customer purchasing power and effective upselling strategies.

AOV analysis supports pricing optimization, product bundling strategies, and helps identify opportunities to increase revenue per transaction through improved merchandising and customer experience enhancements.

IShoppingMallGlobalSearch.IRequest.description:
Global search criteria including search query, filters, and pagination parameters for comprehensive shopping mall platform searches.

This schema defines the request structure for performing comprehensive searches across the entire shopping mall ecosystem. Users can search across products, categories, customers, sellers, sales, orders, coupons, promotions, articles, and reviews with advanced filtering capabilities.

The search request supports text queries with partial matching, entity type filtering, date ranges, price ranges, status filters, and pagination controls to efficiently locate relevant information across the platform. Results are categorized by entity type and include relevant metadata for quick identification of matches.

Security considerations ensure that search results are filtered based on the user's authorization level, with appropriate access controls applied to sensitive customer, seller, and order information. Administrative users have access to comprehensive search results while customer users see filtered results based on their permissions.

The search functionality supports complex queries across multiple entity types simultaneously, with relevance scoring and result ranking based on match quality and entity relationships within the shopping mall platform.

query.description:
Search query text to match against entity names, descriptions, and other searchable fields across the shopping mall platform. Supports partial matching, keyword searching, and fuzzy matching across multiple entity types including products, categories, customers, sellers, and content articles.

Queries can include product names, category titles, customer names, seller business names, article titles, and review content. The search engine performs intelligent matching across all relevant fields with relevance scoring for result ranking.

Maximum query length is 500 characters to ensure optimal search performance across the platform's extensive data set.

oneOf.description: Search across product catalog including product names, descriptions, and attributes
Search across product categories including category names and descriptions
Search across customer accounts including names and contact information
Search across seller accounts including business names and descriptions
Search across sales transactions including sale details and customer information
Search across customer orders including order details and tracking information
Search across discount coupons including coupon codes and descriptions
Search across marketing promotions including promotion names and campaign details
Search across content articles including titles, content, and author information
Search across product and service reviews including review content and ratings

entityTypes.description:
Specific entity types to include in the search results across the shopping mall platform. If empty, searches across all available entity types with appropriate access controls based on user authorization level.

Each entity type represents a distinct category of searchable content within the platform. The search engine will only return results from the specified entity types, optimizing performance by excluding irrelevant data sources.

Administrative users can search across all entity types, while customer users are restricted to product, category, article, and review searches only for security and privacy compliance.

filters.description:
Advanced filtering options to narrow down search results based on specific criteria across the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities including price ranges, status values, date ranges, category filters, seller filters, and other entity-specific criteria. Filters are applied after the initial text search to refine the result set and improve search precision.

Each filter type is optional and only entities matching all specified filter criteria will be included in the final search results. Multiple filters can be combined for highly specific search queries.

pagination.description:
Pagination parameters for controlling result set size and navigation through large search result sets.

Standard pagination controls including page number, page size, and sorting options ensure efficient navigation through potentially extensive search results. The system supports page sizes from 10 to 100 results per page with optimal performance settings.

Sorting options include relevance (default), alphabetical, date created, price, and other entity-specific sorting criteria to organize search results according to user preferences.

ISearchFilters.description:
Advanced search filters for narrowing down global search results across the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive filtering capabilities based on entity-specific criteria including price ranges, status values, date ranges, category filters, seller filters, promotion types, and other relevant attributes. Filters are applied after the initial text search to refine the result set and improve search precision.

Each filter type is optional and only entities matching all specified filter criteria will be included in the final search results. The filter system supports complex multi-criteria searches with logical AND operations between different filter types.

Security considerations ensure that filters respect user authorization levels, with administrative users having access to more comprehensive filtering options compared to customer users. Filter validation prevents unauthorized access to sensitive customer and seller information.

The filtering system supports platform-specific requirements including sale status filtering, order status tracking, promotion type categorization, article content filtering, and review rating thresholds for comprehensive search refinement capabilities.

priceRange.description:
Price range filter for product and sale searches within the shopping mall platform.

Defines minimum and maximum price values for filtering products, sales, and other price-sensitive entities. Both min and max values are optional, allowing for open-ended range queries.

When both min and max are specified, the filter matches entities with prices falling within the inclusive range. When only min is specified, matches entities with prices greater than or equal to min. When only max is specified, matches entities with prices less than or equal to max.

Price values are specified in the platform's base currency with support for decimal precision up to two decimal places for accurate price filtering.

status.description:
Status filter for entities that support status-based filtering across the shopping mall platform.

Applicable to sales, orders, promotions, and other entities with lifecycle status tracking. Status values are entity-specific and validated against predefined status enumerations.

For sales: 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'pending'. For orders: 'pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'. For promotions: 'active', 'scheduled', 'expired', 'cancelled'.

The status filter ensures that search results only include entities matching the specified lifecycle state, providing precise control over search result relevance.

dateRange.description:
Date range filter for time-sensitive searches across the shopping mall platform.

Defines start and end dates for filtering entities based on creation, modification, or event timestamps. Both start and end dates are optional, allowing for flexible time-based queries.

When both start and end are specified, the filter matches entities with dates falling within the inclusive range. When only start is specified, matches entities with dates after or equal to start. When only end is specified, matches entities with dates before or equal to end.

Supports filtering by creation date, modification date, sale start/end dates, promotion validity periods, and other time-sensitive entity attributes for comprehensive temporal search capabilities.

categoryId.description:
Specific category filter for product searches within the shopping mall platform's hierarchical category system.

Filters products to only those belonging to the specified category or its subcategories. The category ID must be a valid UUID matching an existing category in the platform's category hierarchy.

When specified, the search returns products from the designated category and all its descendant categories, supporting hierarchical category browsing within search results.

The category filter can be combined with other filters for highly specific product searches within particular category branches of the shopping mall's product catalog.

sellerId.description:
Seller filter for product and sale searches within the shopping mall platform.

Filters results to only include products or sales associated with the specified seller. The seller ID must be a valid UUID matching an registered seller account in the platform.

This filter is particularly useful for administrative users monitoring specific seller performance or customers looking for products from preferred sellers. The filter respects authorization controls to prevent unauthorized access to seller information.

When combined with other filters, provides precise control over search results based on seller relationships and business partnerships within the platform.

saleStatus.description:
Sale status filter for precise sales transaction searching within the shopping mall platform.

Filters sales results based on specific sale lifecycle states. Valid values include: 'active' for ongoing sales, 'completed' for finished transactions, 'cancelled' for aborted sales, and 'pending' for sales awaiting confirmation.

This filter enables administrative users to monitor sales performance across different status categories and customers to track their purchase history with status-based filtering.

The sale status filter works in conjunction with other filters to provide comprehensive sales search capabilities with precise status-based result refinement.

orderStatus.description:
Order status filter for customer order tracking and administrative order management searches.

Filters order results based on specific order processing states. Valid values include: 'pending' for new orders, 'confirmed' for accepted orders, 'shipped' for dispatched orders, 'delivered' for completed deliveries, and 'cancelled' for voided orders.

Enables customers to track their order progress and administrative users to manage order processing workflows with status-based search and filtering capabilities.

This filter supports efficient order management and customer service operations within the shopping mall platform's order processing system.

promotionType.description:
Promotion type filter for marketing campaign and discount searching within the shopping mall platform.

Filters promotion results based on specific promotion categories. Valid values include: 'percentage' for percentage-based discounts, 'fixed' for fixed-amount discounts, 'bundle' for product bundle offers, 'free_shipping' for shipping promotions, and 'seasonal' for seasonal campaigns.

Enables administrative users to analyze promotion effectiveness by type and customers to discover relevant discounts based on promotion categories.

The promotion type filter supports comprehensive marketing analysis and customer discount discovery within the platform's promotion management system.

articleType.description:
Article type filter for content management and article discovery searches within the shopping mall platform.

Filters article results based on specific content categories. Valid values include: 'news' for platform announcements, 'guide' for shopping guides, 'review' for product reviews, 'promotional' for marketing content, and 'educational' for customer education materials.

Supports content organization and discovery by allowing users to search for specific types of articles relevant to their needs within the platform's content management system.

This filter enhances the content browsing experience by enabling targeted article searches based on content purpose and category.

reviewRating.description:
Review rating filter for product and service review searches within the shopping mall platform.

Filters review results based on specific rating values from 1 to 5 stars. Can be used to find highly-rated products, identify quality issues, or analyze customer satisfaction across different rating levels.

Enables customers to discover well-reviewed products and administrative users to monitor review quality and identify areas for improvement within the platform's review system.

The rating filter supports precise review-based product discovery and quality assessment capabilities for enhanced shopping experiences.

IPriceRange.description:
Price range specification for filtering search results in the shopping mall platform.

Defines minimum and maximum price values for filtering products and other price-sensitive entities within the shopping mall catalog. Both min and max values are optional, allowing for flexible range queries that support various customer search patterns.

When both min and max are specified, the filter matches entities with prices falling within the inclusive range. When only min is specified, matches entities with prices greater than or equal to min. When only max is specified, matches entities with prices less than or equal to max.

Used extensively in product search, category filtering, and advanced search operations throughout the shopping mall platform. Supports price-based segmentation and budget-conscious shopping experiences for customers.

min.description: Minimum price value for the range filter in USD. Optional - if not specified, no lower bound is applied. Used to filter products priced above a certain threshold, enabling budget-conscious shopping and price-based segmentation.

max.description: Maximum price value for the range filter in USD. Optional - if not specified, no upper bound is applied. Used to filter products priced below a certain threshold, supporting price-conscious shopping and budget filtering capabilities.

IPagination.description:
Pagination parameters for controlling search result sets in the shopping mall platform.

Standard pagination controls for managing large result sets efficiently across product catalogs, search results, and customer-facing lists. Includes page number, page size, and optional sorting parameters for consistent navigation through search results.

The pagination system ensures predictable result ordering and efficient database query performance by limiting the number of records returned per request. Supports various shopping mall entities including products, categories, sales, and customer-facing content.

Default sorting behavior typically prioritizes relevance, popularity, or recency based on the specific entity type and search context.

page.description: Current page number for paginated results. Page numbers start from 1. Used to navigate through large result sets efficiently, supporting browsing of extensive product catalogs and search results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Typical values range from 10 to 100 for optimal user experience. Controls the size of result batches to balance performance and usability.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by. Supported values depend on the entity type being searched. Common shopping mall sorting fields include 'price', 'name', 'popularity', 'createdAt', 'rating', and 'relevance' for different entity contexts.

oneOf.description: Sorting direction: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Default behavior varies by entity type but typically defaults to descending for recency-based sorting and ascending for alphabetical sorting.
Sorting direction: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Default behavior varies by entity type but typically defaults to descending for recency-based sorting and ascending for alphabetical sorting.

sortOrder.description: Sorting direction: ascending (asc) or descending (desc). Default behavior varies by entity type but typically defaults to descending for recency-based sorting and ascending for alphabetical sorting.

IShoppingMallGlobalSearchResult.description:
Global search result containing unified results from multiple entity types across the shopping mall platform.

Provides a unified interface for searching across customers, sellers, products, categories, sales, and articles in a single query. Each result includes basic information for display and type-specific identifiers for detailed navigation. The search result maintains consistency in response structure while supporting diverse entity types with their specific attributes.

Results are ranked by relevance and include pagination support for large result sets. The type field determines which entity-specific reference fields are populated, enabling clients to navigate directly to detailed entity views without additional API calls.

Used in global search operations that span multiple entity types, providing a consistent user experience across different search contexts and entity categories.

type.description: Entity type identifier indicating which type of result this represents. Valid values: customer, seller, product, category, sale, article. Determines which entity-specific fields are populated and available for navigation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the matched entity for detailed navigation and API operations. Used as the primary key for retrieving detailed entity information through type-specific endpoints.

title.description: Display title or name of the matched entity for search result presentation. Provides the primary identifying information that users see in search results and use for entity recognition.

description.description: Brief description or summary of the matched entity for context and additional information. Helps users understand the entity's purpose and relevance to their search query.

relevance_score.description: Search relevance score indicating match quality for result ranking. Higher scores indicate better matches based on search algorithm analysis of query terms against entity content and metadata.

entity_reference.description: Entity-specific reference field containing additional identifiers or context information. Format varies by entity type and provides navigation context for detailed entity views.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ISummary.description:
Summary view of wishlist item for display in wishlist summaries and quick reference scenarios.

Provides essential item information including the product reference, variant details, and addition timestamp for efficient display in wishlist interfaces. The summary format optimizes performance while maintaining sufficient context for user decision-making.

Used in wishlist listings, customer dashboards, and quick reference scenarios where full wishlist item details are not required. Supports customer wishlist management by providing key product information and addition context.

Maintains relationships with product catalog for accurate product representation and supports variant-specific wishlist items when customers select specific product variations.

id.description: Unique wishlist item identifier for reference and management operations. Used as the primary key for wishlist item updates, deletions, and detailed retrievals.

product.description: Product reference containing essential product information for wishlist item context. Includes product name, pricing, and seller details for customer reference.

product_variant_id.description: Specific product variant identifier when the wishlist item references a particular product variation. Nullable for products without variants or when variant selection is not applicable.

quantity.description: Desired quantity of the product in the wishlist. Defaults to 1 and supports bulk wishlist additions for future purchases.

added_at.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist. Used for sorting and organizing wishlist items by addition date.

notes.description: Customer notes or reminders associated with the wishlist item. Optional field for personal wishlist management and purchase planning.

total_sales.description:
Total number of sales transactions completed within the specified period.

Represents the count of finalized sales transactions that have been successfully processed and paid. This metric provides insight into transaction volume and business activity levels.

Higher values indicate increased customer purchasing activity and successful order conversions.

total_revenue.description:
Total revenue generated from all sales transactions.

Represents the sum of all sale_amount values from completed transactions. This is the gross revenue before commissions and fees are deducted.

This metric is crucial for understanding overall business performance and revenue generation capabilities.

average_order_value.description:
Average amount per sale transaction.

Calculated as total_revenue divided by total_sales. This metric helps understand customer spending patterns and transaction value trends.

Higher values indicate customers are purchasing more expensive items or larger quantities per transaction.

commission_earned.description:
Total platform commission earned from sales.

Represents the sum of commission amounts calculated as sale_amount multiplied by commission_rate for each transaction.

This metric tracks the platform's revenue share from marketplace transactions.

net_payout.description:
Total amount payable to sellers after commissions.

Represents the sum of net_amount values across all sales transactions. This is the actual amount that will be disbursed to sellers.

This metric helps sellers understand their actual earnings after platform fees.

seller.description:
Seller context for sales statistics scope.

Provides business context for which seller these statistics apply to, enabling seller-specific analytics and performance tracking.

top_selling_categories.description:
Array of top-performing product categories ranked by sales performance.

Provides insights into which product categories are driving the most revenue and transaction volume.

Helps identify popular categories for marketing focus and inventory planning.

sales_trend.description:
Sales trend analysis showing daily performance and growth patterns.

Helps identify seasonal patterns, growth trends, and performance fluctuations over time.

Essential for forecasting and strategic planning.

refund_rate.description:
Percentage of sales that resulted in refunds.

Calculated as (number of refunded sales / total sales) * 100. Lower values indicate better customer satisfaction and product quality.

High refund rates may indicate issues with product descriptions, quality, or customer expectations.

IShoppingMallSaleStatistics.description:
Comprehensive sales statistics and analytics for the shopping mall platform.

Provides detailed insights into sales performance, revenue generation, and marketplace activity.

Used by administrators, sellers, and business analysts to monitor performance, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

Includes key metrics such as transaction volume, revenue totals, average order values, commission earnings, and payout calculations.

Also provides category performance analysis and sales trend data for strategic planning and optimization.

total_products.description:
Total number of products available in the catalog.

Represents the count of active products across all sellers and categories.

This metric indicates the breadth and diversity of the product catalog available to customers.

active_products.description:
Number of products currently available for sale.

Excludes products with status 'draft', 'inactive', or 'archived'. Shows the actual inventory available to customers.

Higher values indicate a well-stocked marketplace with diverse purchasing options.

low_stock_products.description:
Number of products with stock quantity below threshold.

Helps identify products that need restocking attention. Typically uses a threshold like stock_quantity < 10.

Proactive management of low stock items prevents lost sales opportunities.

out_of_stock_products.description:
Number of products with zero inventory available.

Products with stock_quantity = 0 that cannot be purchased until restocked.

High values indicate inventory management issues and potential lost revenue.

average_price.description:
Average price of products in the catalog.

Calculated as the mean of all active product prices. Provides insight into the pricing strategy and market positioning.

Helps understand whether the platform focuses on budget, mid-range, or premium products.

price_range.description:
Price distribution analysis showing the range of product pricing.

Helps understand the diversity of price points available to customers.

Wide ranges indicate a marketplace catering to different budget segments.

category_distribution.description:
Distribution of products across different categories.

Shows which categories have the most product variety and which may need more seller participation.

Helps identify category gaps and opportunities for expansion.

seller_distribution.description:
Distribution of products across different sellers.

Shows which sellers are most active in listing products and maintaining inventory.

Helps identify top contributors and opportunities for seller engagement.

inventory_value.description:
Total value of all inventory based on cost prices.

Calculated as sum of (stock_quantity * cost_price) for all products. Represents the investment value of inventory.

Important for financial planning and inventory management decisions.

turnover_rate.description:
Estimated inventory turnover rate based on sales velocity.

Higher rates indicate faster selling products and efficient inventory management.

Lower rates may indicate overstocking or slow-moving products.

IShoppingMallProductStatistics.description:
Comprehensive product catalog statistics and inventory analytics.

Provides detailed insights into product diversity, inventory management, and catalog composition.

Used by administrators, sellers, and merchandisers to monitor product availability, pricing strategies, and inventory health.

Includes metrics for total product count, active inventory levels, stock status, pricing analysis, and category/seller distributions.

Helps identify opportunities for catalog expansion, inventory optimization, and strategic merchandising decisions.

category.description:
Product category reference providing organizational context for sales performance analysis.

Identifies which specific product category these sales statistics apply to, enabling precise category-specific performance evaluation.
The category summary includes essential information like name, display order, and active status for proper contextual understanding.

Used to correlate sales metrics with specific product categories for strategic business planning and inventory management decisions.

sales_count.description:
Total number of sales transactions completed within this specific product category.

Represents the transaction volume metric for category performance evaluation.
Higher values indicate popular categories that attract significant customer interest and purchasing activity.

This metric helps identify which categories drive the most customer engagement and transaction frequency.
Used for inventory planning, marketing strategy development, and category performance benchmarking.

revenue.description:
Total monetary revenue generated from all sales transactions within this product category.

Shows the financial contribution of each category to overall platform revenue.
Helps identify which categories contribute most significantly to profitability and revenue growth.

This metric is essential for financial analysis, category profitability assessment, and strategic resource allocation decisions.
Enables calculation of average transaction value per category and revenue distribution analysis.

IShoppingMallCategorySalesSummary.description:
Comprehensive sales summary for specific product categories within the shopping mall analytics system.

Provides detailed category-level performance metrics for strategic business analysis and decision-making.
This schema enables merchants and administrators to understand which product categories perform best in terms of transaction volume and revenue generation.

The category sales summary is used extensively in dashboard reporting, performance analytics, and strategic planning tools.
It helps identify high-performing categories for potential expansion and underperforming categories that may need marketing support or restructuring.

Each metric provides complementary insights - sales count indicates customer engagement frequency, while revenue shows financial contribution.
Together they enable comprehensive category performance evaluation across multiple dimensions.

date.description:
Specific calendar date for which sales performance data is recorded and analyzed.

Uses ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) to ensure consistent date representation across all systems and reporting tools.
Enables precise time-series analysis and trend identification over specific date ranges and periods.

This temporal dimension allows for daily performance tracking, seasonal pattern identification, and historical trend analysis.
Essential for comparing performance across different time periods and identifying growth patterns.

sales_count.description:
Total number of sales transactions completed on this specific calendar date.

Provides granular daily transaction volume data for detailed performance analysis and trend identification.
Helps identify daily patterns such as weekend spikes, weekday consistency, and holiday peak periods.

This metric is crucial for understanding customer shopping behavior patterns and seasonal fluctuations.
Enables capacity planning, staffing optimization, and marketing campaign timing decisions based on historical transaction patterns.

revenue.description:
Total monetary revenue generated from all sales transactions completed on this specific date.

Shows daily revenue performance for comprehensive financial tracking and trend analysis.
Enables calculation of daily average order values, revenue growth patterns, and seasonal revenue fluctuations.

This financial metric is essential for cash flow management, revenue forecasting, and financial performance evaluation.
Helps identify peak revenue days and seasonal revenue patterns for strategic business planning.

IShoppingMallDailySalesData.description:
Detailed daily sales performance data for comprehensive trend analysis and business intelligence.

Provides granular day-by-day performance metrics that enable detailed trend analysis and pattern identification.
This schema is fundamental for understanding daily sales patterns, seasonal fluctuations, and growth trends over time.

Used extensively in sales dashboards, financial reporting, and business intelligence systems for daily performance monitoring.
The daily granularity allows for precise tracking of marketing campaign effectiveness, holiday performance, and weekly shopping patterns.

Each data point provides valuable insights - date context enables temporal analysis, sales count shows transaction volume patterns,
and revenue provides the financial performance perspective essential for business decision-making.

This schema supports various analytical use cases including year-over-year comparisons, seasonal trend analysis,
and daily performance benchmarking against business targets and historical averages.

daily_sales.description:
Daily sales data for trend analysis over time.

Provides granular day-by-day performance metrics for detailed trend analysis.

Helps identify patterns such as weekend spikes, holiday peaks, and seasonal trends.

growth_rate.description:
Percentage growth compared to previous period.

Calculated as ((current period revenue - previous period revenue) / previous period revenue) * 100.

Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline in sales performance.

IShoppingMallSalesTrend.description:
Sales trend analysis showing daily performance and growth patterns.

Helps identify seasonal patterns, growth trends, and performance fluctuations over time.

Essential for forecasting and strategic planning.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shopping mall configuration settings optimized for list displays and quick reference.

This summary representation provides essential configuration information for administrative interfaces and configuration management dashboards. It includes key fields needed for identifying and managing platform settings while excluding sensitive data and detailed configuration values. The summary focuses on configuration metadata such as key, scope, environment, and status indicators, allowing administrators to quickly browse and locate specific settings without loading the full configuration details.

This lightweight format supports efficient pagination and search operations across large configuration sets. Proper summary design ensures that configuration management interfaces remain responsive while providing sufficient context for administrative decision-making and operational oversight. Configuration summaries are used in list views, search results, and dashboard displays where comprehensive configuration details are not immediately required.

The summary maintains a balance between information density and performance, including critical identification fields while omitting potentially large configuration values that are better suited for detailed views. This approach supports scalable configuration management across diverse platform environments and deployment scenarios.

id.description: Unique identifier of the configuration setting. Used for referencing specific configurations in management operations and providing stable identification across configuration lifecycle changes.

config_key.description: Unique configuration key that identifies the setting. Follows dot notation for hierarchical organization (e.g., 'payment.gateway.timeout'). Essential for configuration identification, lookup operations, and hierarchical navigation within configuration management systems.

data_type.description: Data type of the configuration value. Valid values: string, number, boolean, json, array, object. Guides value parsing, validation, and appropriate UI rendering in administrative interfaces and configuration management tools.

scope.description: Configuration scope defining where the setting applies. Values: global, channel, section, environment. Enables targeted configuration management, scope-based filtering, and hierarchical configuration resolution where more specific settings override general defaults.

environment.description: Target environment for this configuration. Values: development, staging, production, all. Supports environment-specific configuration management, deployment control, and environment-aware configuration resolution for multi-environment platform deployments.

is_encrypted.description: Indicates whether the configuration value should be encrypted at rest. Used for identifying sensitive settings that require special handling, security protocols, and enhanced access controls to protect credentials, API keys, and other confidential configuration data.

version.description: Configuration version number for tracking changes and supporting rollback capabilities. Auto-incremented on updates to maintain configuration history and enable version-aware configuration management with change tracking and audit capabilities.

description.description: Detailed description of the configuration setting's purpose, usage, and acceptable values. Essential for administrative management, providing context for configuration decisions, and supporting configuration documentation and knowledge transfer.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was initially created. Used for chronological sorting, audit trail reference, and configuration lifecycle tracking in configuration management interfaces and administrative dashboards.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified. Tracks configuration changes for version control, audit purposes, and providing visibility into configuration modification history for administrative oversight and compliance requirements.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft-deleted. Allows safe removal while maintaining historical references, supporting configuration lifecycle management, and enabling recovery capabilities for accidentally deleted configurations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated administrator account. Generated automatically upon registration using UUID v4 format.

administrator.description: Authenticated administrator profile information including identification details and role-based permissions.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.IAuthorized.description:
Authentication response containing comprehensive administrator information and session tokens for secure platform access.

Returned after successful login or token refresh operations. Contains JWT tokens for API access along with complete administrator profile information for client-side display and permission validation.

Includes both access and refresh tokens for session management, essential administrator details for UI rendering, and role-based permission information for access control decisions. The response provides all necessary information for administrative dashboard display and subsequent authenticated API operations.

Security considerations include proper token expiration management, account status verification, and permission-based access control. The response structure ensures client applications have complete context for rendering administrative interfaces and enforcing security policies.

sale_status.description:
Filter sales by transaction status values to analyze specific stages of the sales lifecycle.

Use this filter to include only sales with specific status values like 'completed', 'refunded', 'disputed', or 'pending'. This enables focused analysis of successful transactions, refund processing, dispute resolution, or pending sales.

The status filtering supports business intelligence by allowing separate analysis of different transaction states, helping identify patterns in successful sales versus problematic transactions requiring intervention.

seller_ids.description:
Filter sales by specific seller identifiers to analyze performance of individual merchants or business accounts.

Use this filter to focus on sales from particular sellers within the shopping mall platform. Each seller ID corresponds to a registered business entity that manages product listings and order fulfillment.

This filtering capability supports seller performance analysis, commission tracking, and merchant-specific business intelligence reporting.

customer_ids.description:
Filter sales by specific customer identifiers to analyze purchasing patterns of individual shoppers.

Use this filter to examine sales transactions for particular customers, enabling customer segmentation analysis and personalized business intelligence.

This supports customer lifetime value calculations, repeat purchase analysis, and targeted marketing campaign effectiveness measurement.

min_amount.description:
Minimum sale amount filter to include only transactions above a specified value threshold.

Use this filter to focus on higher-value transactions by excluding sales below the specified minimum amount. This supports analysis of premium product sales and high-value customer segments.

The minimum amount filtering helps identify trends in high-value transactions and supports revenue optimization strategies.

max_amount.description:
Maximum sale amount filter to include only transactions below a specified value threshold.

Use this filter to focus on standard-value transactions by excluding sales above the specified maximum amount. This supports analysis of mainstream product sales and average transaction values.

The maximum amount filtering helps identify pricing optimization opportunities and supports inventory management decisions.

category_ids.description:
Filter sales by product category identifiers to analyze performance within specific product classifications.

Use this filter to focus on sales from particular product categories within the shopping mall's hierarchical categorization system. Each category ID corresponds to a defined product classification.

This filtering supports category performance analysis, inventory optimization, and merchandising strategy evaluation across different product types.

IShoppingMallSaleFilters.description:
Comprehensive filter criteria for sales statistics queries providing targeted analysis capabilities.

These filters enable precise segmentation of sales data within the shopping mall platform, supporting detailed business intelligence and performance reporting requirements. The filtering parameters allow administrators and sellers to extract meaningful insights from sales transactions based on multiple dimensions.

Each filter parameter corresponds to key business attributes documented in the Prisma schema, including transaction status, merchant relationships, customer segments, financial thresholds, and product categorization. The filters support both individual and combined usage for complex analytical queries.

The sales filters integrate with the shopping_mall_sales Prisma model, ensuring consistency with the underlying database structure and supporting accurate reporting across the platform's sales transaction ecosystem.

category_ids.description: Filter by product category IDs to focus on specific product classifications in statistics

seller_ids.description: Filter by specific seller IDs to analyze products from particular merchants or business accounts

status.description: Filter by product status values to include specific lifecycle states in product statistics

min_price.description: Minimum price filter to include only products above a specified price threshold

max_price.description: Maximum price filter to include only products below a specified price threshold

inventory_status.description: Filter by inventory status values to analyze products based on stock availability levels

condition.description: Filter by product condition values to focus on items with specific quality classifications

IShoppingMallProductFilters.description:
Filter criteria for product statistics queries providing comprehensive filtering capabilities.

These filters enable targeted analysis of specific product segments and performance metrics within the shopping mall platform, supporting inventory management and catalog optimization.

The filter parameters allow administrators and sellers to extract meaningful insights from product data based on categories, merchant attributes, status, pricing, inventory levels, and product conditions.

oneOf.description:
Group sales data by individual calendar days for daily performance analysis.

Enables tracking of daily sales patterns, identifying peak sales days, and monitoring day-to-day performance fluctuations. Particularly useful for identifying seasonal trends, weekend vs weekday patterns, and short-term promotional effectiveness.

Daily grouping provides the highest granularity for sales analysis, allowing for detailed performance tracking and rapid response to market changes.

Group sales data by calendar weeks for weekly performance analysis.

Enables comparison of week-over-week performance, identification of weekly sales cycles, and tracking of weekly growth trends. Useful for weekly reporting, performance reviews, and identifying patterns that span multiple days.

Weekly grouping balances granularity with meaningful time periods for business analysis and strategic planning.

Group sales data by calendar months for monthly performance analysis.

Enables month-over-month comparison, seasonal trend analysis, and monthly financial reporting. Essential for budgeting, financial planning, and identifying longer-term sales patterns.

Monthly grouping provides a standard business cycle perspective that aligns with financial reporting and strategic planning cycles.

Group sales data by business quarters for quarterly performance analysis.

Enables quarterly business reviews, seasonal trend analysis across multiple months, and strategic planning cycles. Essential for executive reporting, investor communications, and long-term strategic planning.

Quarterly grouping provides a high-level perspective on business performance across seasonal cycles and market trends.

Group sales data by calendar years for annual performance analysis.

Enables year-over-year comparison, long-term trend analysis, and annual strategic planning. Essential for annual reports, performance reviews, and long-term business strategy development.

Yearly grouping provides the broadest perspective on business performance and market position over time.

Group sales data by individual sellers for performance analysis.

Enables seller performance tracking, commission calculations, and identification of top-performing sellers. Essential for seller management, performance optimization, and commission-based incentive programs.

Seller grouping provides insights into individual seller effectiveness and helps optimize seller support and training programs.

Group sales data by individual customers for customer behavior analysis.

Enables customer segmentation analysis, customer lifetime value calculation, and identification of high-value customers. Essential for customer relationship management, targeted marketing, and loyalty program optimization.

Customer grouping provides insights into customer purchasing patterns and helps optimize customer retention strategies.

Group sales data by product categories for category performance analysis.

Enables category performance tracking, inventory optimization, and identification of high-performing product categories. Essential for category management, merchandising strategy, and product assortment optimization.

Category grouping provides insights into product category performance and helps optimize product placement and marketing strategies.

Group sales data by individual products for product performance analysis.
